CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_control_campaign(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_idempotency_key text, p_campaign jsonb, p_inputs jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET statement_timeout TO '60s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_campaign_id bigint;
  v_account_id bigint;
  v_action_id text;
  v_action_platform text;
  v_account_platform text;
  v_input_count integer := 0;
  v_key text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_idempotency_key, '')), '');
BEGIN
  IF p_staff_id IS NULL OR p_staff_id <= 0 OR p_organization_id IS NULL OR p_organization_id <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_control_identity';
  END IF;
  IF v_key IS NULL OR length(v_key) > 200 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_idempotency_key';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_campaign, '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object'
    OR jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_inputs, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_control_campaign_payload';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p_inputs, '[]'::jsonb)) > 5000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'too_many_campaign_inputs';
  END IF;

  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(p_staff_id::text || ':' || v_key, 0));

  SELECT campaign.id INTO v_campaign_id
  FROM public.auto_campaigns AS campaign
  WHERE campaign.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND campaign.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND campaign.control_idempotency_key = v_key
  LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    PERFORM account.id
    FROM public.auto_campaigns AS campaign
    JOIN public.auto_accounts AS account ON account.id = campaign.account_id
    WHERE campaign.id = v_campaign_id
      AND campaign.staff_id = p_staff_id
      AND campaign.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND account.staff_id = p_staff_id
      AND account.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND (
        account.flatform_type = 'sms'
        OR (
          account.flatform_type = 'zalo'
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
        )
      )
      AND COALESCE(account.is_delete, false) = false
    FOR UPDATE OF account;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'control_account_not_found';
    END IF;

    SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_input_count
    FROM public.auto_campaign_input_data
    WHERE campaign_id = v_campaign_id AND COALESCE(is_delete, false) = false;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'campaign_id', v_campaign_id,
      'input_count', v_input_count,
      'created', false
    );
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.org_staff
    WHERE id = p_staff_id AND organization_id = p_organization_id AND is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inactive_control_staff';
  END IF;

  v_account_id := NULLIF(p_campaign->>'accountId', '')::bigint;
  v_action_id := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_campaign->>'actionId', '')), '');
  IF v_account_id IS NULL OR v_action_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'campaign_account_and_action_required';
  END IF;

  SELECT account.flatform_type INTO v_account_platform
  FROM public.auto_accounts AS account
  WHERE account.id = v_account_id
    AND account.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND account.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND (
      account.flatform_type = 'sms'
      OR (
        account.flatform_type = 'zalo'
        AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
        AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
        AND COALESCE(account.is_active, true) = true
      )
    )
    AND COALESCE(account.is_delete, false) = false
  FOR UPDATE OF account;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'control_account_not_found';
  END IF;

  SELECT action.flatform_type INTO v_action_platform
  FROM public.auto_campaign_actions AS action
  WHERE action.id = v_action_id
    AND action.flatform_type IN ('zalo', 'sms')
    AND COALESCE(action.is_active, true) = true
    AND COALESCE(action.is_delete, false) = false;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_action_platform IS DISTINCT FROM v_account_platform THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'control_action_not_allowed';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.auto_campaigns (
    name, action_id, account_id, status, schedule, original_schedule,
    content, schedule_type, schedule_end_date,
    daily_stop_time, schedule_days, schedule_week_days, continue_next_day,
    refresh_data, extra_settings, images, is_delete, staff_id, organization_id,
    control_idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    btrim(p_campaign->>'name'),
    v_action_id,
    v_account_id,
    'chờ xử lý',
    NULLIF(p_campaign->>'schedule', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(p_campaign->>'schedule', '')::timestamptz,
    COALESCE(p_campaign->>'content', ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(p_campaign->>'scheduleType', ''), 'daily'),
    NULLIF(p_campaign->>'scheduleEndDate', '')::timestamptz,
    NULLIF(p_campaign->>'dailyStopTime', '')::time,
    NULLIF(p_campaign->>'scheduleDays', ''),
    NULLIF(p_campaign->>'scheduleWeekDays', ''),
    COALESCE((p_campaign->>'continueNextDay')::boolean, false),
    COALESCE((p_campaign->>'refreshData')::boolean, false),
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_campaign->'extraSettings') = 'object'
      THEN p_campaign->'extraSettings' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END,
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_campaign->'images') = 'array'
      THEN p_campaign->'images' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
    false,
    p_staff_id,
    p_organization_id,
    v_key,
    now(),
    now()
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_campaign_id;

  INSERT INTO public.auto_campaign_input_data (
    campaign_id, input_id, name, phone, phone_carrier, uid, email,
    info1, info2, info3, info4, info5, content,
    status, note, schedule, is_delete, created_at
  )
  SELECT
    v_campaign_id,
    NULL,
    NULLIF(item->>'name', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'phone', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'phoneCarrier', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'uid', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'email', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'info1', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'info2', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'info3', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'info4', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'info5', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'content', ''),
    'chờ xử lý',
    NULLIF(item->>'note', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'schedule', '')::timestamptz,
    false,
    now()
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_inputs, '[]'::jsonb)) AS item;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_input_count = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'campaign_id', v_campaign_id,
    'input_count', v_input_count,
    'created', true
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_control_zalo_account_atomic(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_max_accounts integer, p_account jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_account_id bigint;
  v_account_count integer := 0;
  v_account_group_id bigint := NULLIF(p_account->>'accountGroupId', '')::bigint;
  v_proxy_id bigint := NULLIF(p_account->>'proxyId', '')::bigint;
  v_server_pool record;
  v_pool_subtypes text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
  v_resource_local_count integer := 0;
  v_resource_server_count integer := 0;
  v_resource_lock_key bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_staff_id IS NULL OR p_staff_id <= 0
    OR p_organization_id IS NULL OR p_organization_id <= 0
    OR jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_account, '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object'
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_account->>'name', '')), '') IS NULL
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_control_zalo_account_payload';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.org_staff AS staff
  WHERE staff.id = p_staff_id
    AND staff.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND staff.is_active = true
  FOR SHARE OF staff;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inactive_control_staff';
  END IF;

  -- Match the existing resource-lock ordering so account creation cannot race
  -- group/proxy reassignment or deadlock another Control mutation.
  FOR v_resource_lock_key IN
    SELECT DISTINCT resource.lock_key
    FROM (
      VALUES
        (
          CASE
            WHEN v_account_group_id IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE hashtextextended(
              'control-zalo-account-group:' || v_account_group_id::text,
              0
            )
          END
        ),
        (
          CASE
            WHEN v_proxy_id IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE hashtextextended(
              'control-zalo-proxy:' || v_proxy_id::text,
              0
            )
          END
        )
    ) AS resource(lock_key)
    WHERE resource.lock_key IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY resource.lock_key
  LOOP
    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(v_resource_lock_key);
  END LOOP;

  IF v_account_group_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM account_group.id
    FROM public.auto_account_groups AS account_group
    WHERE account_group.id = v_account_group_id
      AND account_group.staff_id = p_staff_id
      AND account_group.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND account_group.flatform_type = 'zalo'
      AND COALESCE(account_group.is_delete, false) = false
    FOR UPDATE OF account_group;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'created', false,
        'reason', 'account_group_not_found'
      );
    END IF;

    SELECT
      count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE lower(btrim(COALESCE(account.flatform_type, ''))) = 'zalo'
          AND NOT (
            COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
            AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
          )
      )::integer,
      count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE lower(btrim(COALESCE(account.flatform_type, ''))) = 'zalo'
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
      )::integer
    INTO v_resource_local_count, v_resource_server_count
    FROM public.auto_accounts AS account
    WHERE account.staff_id = p_staff_id
      AND account.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND account.account_group_id = v_account_group_id
      AND COALESCE(account.is_delete, false) = false;

    IF v_resource_local_count > 0 AND v_resource_server_count = 0 THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'created', false,
        'reason', 'account_group_local_only'
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_proxy_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    PERFORM proxy.id
    FROM public.auto_proxies AS proxy
    WHERE proxy.id = v_proxy_id
      AND proxy.staff_id = p_staff_id
      AND proxy.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND COALESCE(proxy.is_delete, false) = false
    FOR UPDATE OF proxy;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'created', false,
        'reason', 'proxy_not_found'
      );
    END IF;

    SELECT
      count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE NOT (
          lower(btrim(COALESCE(account.flatform_type, ''))) = 'zalo'
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
        )
      )::integer,
      count(*) FILTER (
        WHERE lower(btrim(COALESCE(account.flatform_type, ''))) = 'zalo'
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
          AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
      )::integer
    INTO v_resource_local_count, v_resource_server_count
    FROM public.auto_accounts AS account
    WHERE account.staff_id = p_staff_id
      AND account.organization_id = p_organization_id
      AND account.proxy_id = v_proxy_id
      AND COALESCE(account.is_delete, false) = false;

    IF v_resource_local_count > 0 AND v_resource_server_count = 0 THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'created', false,
        'reason', 'proxy_local_only'
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- Resource locks precede entitlement and staff-quota locks, matching the
  -- current trigger/RPC order.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(
    hashtextextended('aka-agent-zalo-runtime-entitlement-mutation', 0)
  );

  SELECT *
  INTO v_server_pool
  FROM private.resolve_organization_zalo_entitlement_pools(p_organization_id)
  WHERE account_subtype = 'server';

  IF v_server_pool.entitlement_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'created', false,
      'reason', 'capability_unavailable'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(
    array_agg(pool.account_subtype ORDER BY pool.account_subtype),
    ARRAY[]::text[]
  )
  INTO v_pool_subtypes
  FROM private.resolve_organization_zalo_entitlement_pools(
    p_organization_id
  ) AS pool
  WHERE pool.entitlement_id = v_server_pool.entitlement_id;

  -- p_max_accounts remains wire-compatible. The resolved Server entitlement
  -- is authoritative.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    hashtextextended('control-zalo-account:' || p_staff_id::text, 0)
  );

  SELECT count(*)::integer
  INTO v_account_count
  FROM public.auto_accounts AS account
  WHERE account.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND (
      account.organization_id IS NULL
      OR account.organization_id = p_organization_id
    )
    AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(account.flatform_type, ''))) = 'zalo'
    AND COALESCE(account.is_delete, false) = false
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) THEN 'web'
        WHEN COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) THEN 'server'
        ELSE 'qr'
      END
    ) = ANY(v_pool_subtypes);

  IF v_server_pool.max_accounts IS NOT NULL
    AND v_server_pool.max_accounts > 0
    AND v_account_count >= v_server_pool.max_accounts
  THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'created', false,
      'reason', 'account_limit_reached',
      'max_accounts', v_server_pool.max_accounts
    );
  END IF;

  -- This Control surface always creates the Server subtype.
  INSERT INTO public.auto_accounts (
    name,
    flatform_type,
    is_zalo_show_web,
    is_zalo_server,
    login_status,
    status,
    is_active,
    account_group_id,
    proxy_id,
    staff_id,
    organization_id,
    is_delete
  )
  VALUES (
    btrim(p_account->>'name'),
    'zalo',
    false,
    true,
    'chưa đăng nhập',
    'chờ xử lý',
    COALESCE((p_account->>'isActive')::boolean, true),
    v_account_group_id,
    v_proxy_id,
    p_staff_id,
    p_organization_id,
    false
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_account_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'created', true,
    'account_id', v_account_id
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_organization(p_customer_id bigint, p_organization_name text, p_organization_phone text, p_organization_email text, p_product_package_id bigint)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_organization_id bigint;
  v_staff_id bigint;
  v_group_id bigint;
  v_customer record;
  v_package record;
  v_product record;
BEGIN
  SELECT *
  INTO v_customer
  FROM public.org_customer
  WHERE id = p_customer_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Khong tim thay customer %', p_customer_id;
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_package
  FROM public.org_product_package
  WHERE id = p_product_package_id;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Khong tim thay package %', p_product_package_id;
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_product
  FROM public.org_product
  WHERE id = v_package.product_id;

  INSERT INTO public.org_organization (
    customer_id,
    name,
    phone,
    email,
    max_staff
  )
  VALUES (
    p_customer_id,
    p_organization_name,
    p_organization_phone,
    p_organization_email,
    v_package.max_staff
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_organization_id;

  INSERT INTO public.org_staff (
    organization_id,
    customer_id,
    name,
    phone,
    email,
    username,
    password
  )
  VALUES (
    v_organization_id,
    p_customer_id,
    v_customer.name,
    v_customer.phone,
    v_customer.email,
    v_organization_id::text || '.' || v_customer.phone,
    '123456'
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_staff_id;

  UPDATE public.org_organization
  SET staff_admin_id = v_staff_id
  WHERE id = v_organization_id;

  INSERT INTO public.org_group (
    organization_id,
    parent_id,
    name
  )
  VALUES (
    v_organization_id,
    NULL,
    p_organization_name
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_group_id;

  INSERT INTO public.org_group_staff (
    group_id,
    staff_id,
    organization_id,
    is_admin
  )
  VALUES (
    v_group_id,
    v_staff_id,
    v_organization_id,
    true
  );

  INSERT INTO public.org_organization_product (
    organization_id,
    product_package_id,
    organization_phone,
    organization_email,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    package_name,
    package_type,
    max_accounts,
    max_staff,
    duration_days,
    max_sends_per_day,
    is_zalo_server,
    is_zalo_show_web,
    purchase_date,
    trial_start_date,
    expiration_date
  )
  VALUES (
    v_organization_id,
    p_product_package_id,
    p_organization_phone,
    p_organization_email,
    v_product.id,
    v_product.name,
    v_package.name,
    v_package.package_type,
    v_package.max_account,
    v_package.max_staff,
    v_package.duration_days,
    v_package.max_sends_per_day,
    COALESCE(v_package.is_zalo_server, false),
    COALESCE(v_package.is_zalo_show_web, false),
    CASE
      WHEN v_package.package_type <> 'demo' THEN now()
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN v_package.package_type = 'demo' THEN now()
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    now() + (v_package.duration_days || ' days')::interval
  );

  RETURN v_organization_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_agent_campaign_results(p_organization_ids bigint[], p_campaign_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id bigint, successful bigint, failed bigint, pending bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT c.id, result.successful, result.failed, result.managed_pending + queue.pending
  FROM public.auto_campaigns c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (d.report_group='success' OR (d.report_group IS NULL AND d.status IN ('thành công', 'đã gửi', 'đã nhận', 'đã xem', 'đã click')))) AS successful,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE (d.report_group='failure' OR (d.report_group IS NULL AND d.status IN ('thất bại', 'lỗi', 'không tồn tại')))) AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE d.report_group='pending') AS managed_pending
    FROM public.auto_campaign_details d
    WHERE d.campaign_id = c.id AND d.is_delete = false
  ) result
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*) AS pending
    FROM public.auto_campaign_input_data i
    WHERE i.campaign_id = c.id AND i.is_delete = false AND i.status = 'chờ xử lý'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.auto_campaign_details existing
        WHERE existing.input_data_id=i.id AND existing.campaign_id=c.id
          AND existing.is_delete=false AND existing.report_group='pending')
  ) queue
  WHERE c.organization_id = ANY(p_organization_ids) AND c.id = ANY(p_campaign_ids) AND c.is_delete = false;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.crm_trial_campaign_signal_counts(p_organization_ids bigint[], p_campaign_ids bigint[])
 RETURNS TABLE(campaign_id bigint, input_total bigint, successful bigint, failed bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT c.id, inputs.input_total, result.successful, result.failed
  FROM public.auto_campaigns c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT count(*) AS input_total
    FROM public.auto_campaign_input_data i
    WHERE i.campaign_id = c.id AND i.is_delete = false
  ) inputs
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    -- Số LIÊN HỆ có ít nhất một lượt thành công / lỗi (một liên hệ có thể được gửi nhiều lượt), để tỷ lệ
    -- "đã gửi / tệp nạp" cùng nghĩa với SQL autoCampaignDetail và tracking desktop (mỗi dòng = một liên hệ).
    SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.input_data_id, d.id)) FILTER (
             WHERE (d.report_group='success' OR (d.report_group IS NULL AND d.status IN ('thành công', 'đã gửi', 'đã nhận', 'đã xem', 'đã click')))
           ) AS successful,
           count(DISTINCT COALESCE(d.input_data_id, d.id)) FILTER (
             WHERE (d.report_group='failure' OR (d.report_group IS NULL AND d.status IN ('thất bại', 'lỗi', 'không tồn tại')))
           ) AS failed
    FROM public.auto_campaign_details d
    WHERE d.campaign_id = c.id AND d.is_delete = false
  ) result
  WHERE c.organization_id = ANY(p_organization_ids) AND c.id = ANY(p_campaign_ids) AND c.is_delete = false;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_control_campaign_atomic(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_campaign_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_campaign_status text;
BEGIN
  IF p_staff_id IS NULL OR p_staff_id <= 0
    OR p_organization_id IS NULL OR p_organization_id <= 0
    OR p_campaign_id IS NULL OR p_campaign_id <= 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_control_identity';
  END IF;

  -- This is an optimistic platform read only; it deliberately takes no campaign
  -- row lock. The mutation locks input rows before taking the campaign row lock.
  SELECT campaign.status
  INTO v_campaign_status
  FROM public.auto_campaigns AS campaign
  JOIN public.auto_accounts AS account ON account.id = campaign.account_id
  WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
    AND campaign.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND campaign.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND COALESCE(campaign.is_delete, false) = false
    AND account.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND account.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND (
      account.flatform_type = 'sms'
      OR (
        account.flatform_type = 'zalo'
        AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
        AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
      )
    );

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('deleted', false, 'reason', 'not_found');
  END IF;

  PERFORM public.aka_agent_lock_campaign_input_serialization(p_campaign_id);

  PERFORM input_data.id
  FROM public.auto_campaign_input_data AS input_data
  WHERE input_data.campaign_id = p_campaign_id
    AND COALESCE(input_data.is_delete, false) = false
  ORDER BY input_data.id
  FOR UPDATE OF input_data;

  SELECT campaign.status
  INTO v_campaign_status
  FROM public.auto_campaigns AS campaign
  JOIN public.auto_accounts AS account ON account.id = campaign.account_id
  WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
    AND campaign.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND campaign.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND COALESCE(campaign.is_delete, false) = false
    AND account.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND account.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND (
      account.flatform_type = 'sms'
      OR (
        account.flatform_type = 'zalo'
        AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_show_web, false) = false
        AND COALESCE(account.is_zalo_server, false) = true
      )
    )
  FOR UPDATE OF campaign, account;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('deleted', false, 'reason', 'not_found');
  END IF;
  IF v_campaign_status = 'đang chạy' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('deleted', false, 'reason', 'campaign_running');
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.auto_campaigns AS campaign
  SET is_delete = true, updated_at = now()
  WHERE campaign.id = p_campaign_id
    AND campaign.staff_id = p_staff_id
    AND campaign.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND COALESCE(campaign.is_delete, false) = false
    AND campaign.status <> 'đang chạy';

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('deleted', false, 'reason', 'campaign_running');
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('deleted', true, 'campaign_id', p_campaign_id);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.discover_zalo_server_account_runtime_users(p_after_staff_id bigint DEFAULT 0, p_limit integer DEFAULT 1000)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
 SET statement_timeout TO '60s'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_page_size integer := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 1000), 1), 1000);
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_after_staff_id IS NULL OR p_after_staff_id < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'After staff ID must be zero or greater';
  END IF;

  WITH organization_capabilities AS (
    SELECT capabilities.*, organizations.organization_id
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT entitlement.organization_id
      FROM public.org_organization_product AS entitlement
      WHERE entitlement.product_id IN (16, 18)
        AND entitlement.is_deleted = false
        AND entitlement.expiration_date IS NOT NULL
        AND entitlement.expiration_date >= (
          date_trunc('day', timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', now()))
            AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
        )
    ) AS organizations
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.resolve_organization_zalo_account_capabilities(
      organizations.organization_id
    ) AS capabilities
    WHERE capabilities.qr_enabled = true
      AND capabilities.server_enabled = true
  ),
  page_candidates AS (
    SELECT
      staff.id AS staff_id,
      staff.organization_id,
      staff.name AS staff_name,
      staff.phone AS staff_phone,
      staff.username,
      COALESCE(staff.is_admin_akabiz, false) AS is_admin_akabiz,
      COALESCE(staff.use_test_workflow, false) AS use_test_workflow,
      organization.name AS organization_name,
      capabilities.entitlement_id,
      capabilities.capability_revision AS mode_revision,
      capabilities.product_id,
      capabilities.product_name,
      capabilities.package_name,
      capabilities.package_type,
      capabilities.expiration_date,
      capabilities.max_sends_per_day,
      capabilities.max_accounts,
      capabilities.created_at,
      capabilities.qr_enabled,
      capabilities.web_enabled,
      capabilities.server_enabled
    FROM organization_capabilities AS capabilities
    JOIN public.aka_agent_staff_runtime_profile AS staff
      ON staff.organization_id = capabilities.organization_id
    JOIN public.org_organization AS organization
      ON organization.id = staff.organization_id
    WHERE staff.is_active = true AND public.aka_agent_staff_time_allowed(staff.id)
      AND staff.id > p_after_staff_id
    ORDER BY staff.id ASC
    LIMIT v_page_size + 1
  ),
  page_items AS (
    SELECT candidate.*
    FROM page_candidates AS candidate
    ORDER BY candidate.staff_id ASC
    LIMIT v_page_size
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'staff_id', item.staff_id,
          'organization_id', item.organization_id,
          'staff_name', item.staff_name,
          'staff_phone', item.staff_phone,
          'username', item.username,
          'is_admin_akabiz', item.is_admin_akabiz,
          'use_test_workflow', item.use_test_workflow,
          'organization_name', item.organization_name,
          'entitlement_id', item.entitlement_id,
          'mode_revision', item.mode_revision,
          'product_id', item.product_id,
          'product_name', item.product_name,
          'package_name', item.package_name,
          'package_type', item.package_type,
          'expiration_date', item.expiration_date,
          'max_sends_per_day', item.max_sends_per_day,
          'max_accounts', item.max_accounts,
          'created_at', item.created_at,
          'zalo_qr_enabled', item.qr_enabled,
          'zalo_web_enabled', item.web_enabled,
          'zalo_server_enabled', item.server_enabled
        ) ORDER BY item.staff_id ASC
      ) FROM page_items AS item
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next_after_staff_id', CASE
      WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM page_candidates) > v_page_size
        THEN (SELECT max(item.staff_id) FROM page_items AS item)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) INTO v_result;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

      mode.max_sends_per_day,
      mode.max_accounts,

    JOIN public.org_organization AS organization

    WHERE staff.is_active = true
      AND staff.id > p_after_staff_id
    ORDER BY staff.id ASC
    LIMIT v_page_size + 1

    FROM page_candidates AS candidate
    ORDER BY candidate.staff_id ASC
    LIMIT v_page_size
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'staff_id', item.staff_id,
          'organization_id', item.organization_id,
          'staff_name', item.staff_name,
          'staff_phone', item.staff_phone,
          'username', item.username,
          'is_admin_akabiz', item.is_admin_akabiz,
          'use_test_workflow', item.use_test_workflow,
          'organization_name', item.organization_name,
          'entitlement_id', item.entitlement_id,
          'mode_revision', item.mode_revision,
          'product_id', item.product_id,
          'product_name', item.product_name,
          'package_name', item.package_name,
          'package_type', item.package_type,
          'expiration_date', item.expiration_date,
          'max_sends_per_day', item.max_sends_per_day,
          'max_accounts', item.max_accounts,
          'created_at', item.created_at
        ) ORDER BY item.staff_id ASC
      ) FROM page_items AS item
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'next_after_staff_id', CASE
      WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM page_candidates) > v_page_size
        THEN (SELECT max(item.staff_id) FROM page_items AS item)

    END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_cskh_activity_crm_candidate(p_event_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_id uuid, event_at timestamp with time zone, customer_id bigint, customer_name text, customer_phone text, org_staff_owner_id bigint, event_reason text, reason text, package_name text, product_list text, expires_at timestamp with time zone, days_left numeric, matched_source text, order_id bigint, organization_product_id bigint, event_package text, event_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with params as (
  select pg_catalog.statement_timestamp() as checked_at
),
ev as (
  select
    t.id,
    coalesce(t.event_timestamp, t.created_at, pg_catalog.statement_timestamp()) as event_at,
    public.normalize_phone(t.phone) as phone,
    t.account_id,
    nullif(pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(t.account_package)), '') as account_package,
    t.account_created_at,
    t.account_expired_at,
    t.account_product_list
  from public.aka_tracking_app t
  where t.id = p_event_id
    and t.event_type in ('login', 'login_app_akabiz', 'open_app_akabiz')
    and public.normalize_phone(t.phone) is not null
    and pg_catalog.length(public.normalize_phone(t.phone)) >= 9
),
direct_order as (
  select o.id, o.customer_id, o.phone
  from ev
  join lateral (
    select ao.id, ao.customer_id, ao.phone
    from public.aka_order ao
    where ao.account_id_old = ev.account_id
      and coalesce(ao.date_create, ao.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= ev.event_at
    order by ao.updated_at desc nulls last, ao.id desc
    limit 1
  ) o on true
),
cust as (
  select c.id, c.name, c.phone, c.org_staff_id_owner
  from ev
  join lateral (
    -- account_id -> aka_order is unique for recent app events and is the
    -- authoritative customer link inside duplicate normalized-phone groups.
    select ac.id, ac.name, ac.phone, ac.org_staff_id_owner, 1 as priority
    from direct_order d
    join public.aka_customer ac on ac.id = d.customer_id
    where public.normalize_phone(d.phone) = ev.phone
       or public.normalize_phone(ac.phone) = ev.phone

    union all

    -- Only use phone fallback when it resolves to exactly one customer.
    select ac.id, ac.name, ac.phone, ac.org_staff_id_owner, 2 as priority
    from public.aka_customer ac
    where public.normalize_phone(ac.phone) = ev.phone
      and not exists (select 1 from direct_order)
      and (
        select count(*)
        from public.aka_customer same_phone
        where public.normalize_phone(same_phone.phone) = ev.phone
      ) = 1
    order by priority
    limit 1
  ) c on true
),
event_entitlements as (
  select
    'tracking_snapshot'::text as source,
    ev.account_package as package_name,
    ev.account_product_list as product_list,
    null::bigint as order_id,
    null::bigint as organization_product_id,
    ev.account_expired_at as expires_at,
    case
      when ev.account_package in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and pg_catalog.date_part('year', ev.account_expired_at) >= 2090 then 'other'
      when ev.account_created_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and (ev.account_expired_at::date - ev.account_created_at::date) >= 1500 then 'other'
      when ev.account_package ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when ev.account_package ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when ev.account_created_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and (ev.account_expired_at::date - ev.account_created_at::date) >= 200 then 'year'
      when ev.account_created_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and (ev.account_expired_at::date - ev.account_created_at::date) >= 1 then 'month'
      else 'other'
    end as term_group,
    ev.account_expired_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at >= ev.event_at as is_active,
    ev.account_expired_at is null as status_unknown
  from ev
  where ev.account_package is not null
     or ev.account_expired_at is not null

  union all

  select
    'aka_order',
    nullif(pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(o.package)), ''),
    o.product_list,
    o.id,
    null::bigint,
    o.date_expiration,
    case
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when o.date_expiration is not null and pg_catalog.date_part('year', o.date_expiration) >= 2090 then 'other'
      when o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
        and (o.date_expiration::date - o.date_create::date) >= 1500 then 'other'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
        and (o.date_expiration::date - o.date_create::date) >= 200 then 'year'
      when o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
        and (o.date_expiration::date - o.date_create::date) >= 1 then 'month'
      else 'other'
    end,
    coalesce(o.is_active, true) and o.date_expiration is not null and o.date_expiration >= ev.event_at,
    coalesce(o.is_active, true) and o.date_expiration is null
  from ev
  cross join cust
  join public.aka_order o
    on o.account_id_old = ev.account_id
    or o.customer_id = cust.id
    or (
      o.customer_id is null
      and public.normalize_phone(o.phone) = ev.phone
    )
  where coalesce(o.date_create, o.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= ev.event_at

  union all

  select
    'org_organization_product',
    coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(q.package_name), ''), nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(q.package_type), '')),
    q.product_name,
    null::bigint,
    q.id,
    q.expiration_date,
    case
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(q.package_type, '')) in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(q.package_type, '')) ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(q.package_type, '')) ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when q.duration_days between 1 and 199 then 'month'
      when q.duration_days between 200 and 1499 then 'year'
      else 'other'
    end,
    not coalesce(q.is_deleted, false)
      and not coalesce(q.is_lock, false)
      and q.expiration_date is not null
      and q.expiration_date >= ev.event_at,
    not coalesce(q.is_deleted, false)
      and not coalesce(q.is_lock, false)
      and q.expiration_date is null
  from ev
  cross join cust
  join public.org_organization g
    on g.customer_id = cust.id
    or (
      g.customer_id is null
      and public.normalize_phone(g.phone) = ev.phone
    )
  join public.org_organization_product q on q.organization_id = g.id
  where coalesce(q.purchase_date, q.trial_start_date, q.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= ev.event_at
),
event_stats as (
  select
    count(e.source) > 0 as has_history,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(e.is_active), false) as has_active,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(e.status_unknown), false) as has_unknown,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(
      e.is_active and e.term_group = 'month'
      and e.expires_at <= ev.event_at + interval '15 days'
    ), false) as near_month,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(
      e.is_active and e.term_group = 'year'
      and e.expires_at <= ev.event_at + interval '30 days'
    ), false) as near_year
  from ev
  left join event_entitlements e on true
  group by ev.event_at
),
event_class as (
  select case
    when event_stats.near_month then 'monthly_expiring_15d'
    when event_stats.near_year then 'yearly_expiring_30d'
    when event_stats.has_active or event_stats.has_unknown then null
    when event_stats.has_history then 'expired'
    else 'no_package'
  end as reason
  from event_stats
),
current_entitlements as (
  select
    'aka_order'::text as source,
    nullif(pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(o.package)), '') as package_name,
    o.product_list,
    o.id as order_id,
    null::bigint as organization_product_id,
    o.date_expiration as expires_at,
    case
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when o.date_expiration is not null and pg_catalog.date_part('year', o.date_expiration) >= 2090 then 'other'
      when o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
        and (o.date_expiration::date - o.date_create::date) >= 1500 then 'other'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package, '')) ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
        and (o.date_expiration::date - o.date_create::date) >= 200 then 'year'
      when o.date_create is not null and o.date_expiration is not null
        and (o.date_expiration::date - o.date_create::date) >= 1 then 'month'
      else 'other'
    end as term_group,
    coalesce(o.is_active, true) and o.date_expiration is not null and o.date_expiration >= params.checked_at as is_active,
    coalesce(o.is_active, true) and o.date_expiration is null as status_unknown
  from params
  cross join ev
  cross join cust
  join public.aka_order o
    on o.account_id_old = ev.account_id
    or o.customer_id = cust.id
    or (
      o.customer_id is null
      and public.normalize_phone(o.phone) = ev.phone
    )
  where coalesce(o.date_create, o.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= params.checked_at

  union all

  select
    'org_organization_product',
    coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(q.package_name), ''), nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(q.package_type), '')),
    q.product_name,
    null::bigint,
    q.id,
    q.expiration_date,
    case
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(q.package_type, '')) in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(q.package_type, '')) ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(q.package_type, '')) ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when q.duration_days between 1 and 199 then 'month'
      when q.duration_days between 200 and 1499 then 'year'
      else 'other'
    end,
    not coalesce(q.is_deleted, false)
      and not coalesce(q.is_lock, false)
      and q.expiration_date is not null
      and q.expiration_date >= params.checked_at,
    not coalesce(q.is_deleted, false)
      and not coalesce(q.is_lock, false)
      and q.expiration_date is null
  from params
  cross join ev
  cross join cust
  join public.org_organization g
    on g.customer_id = cust.id
    or (
      g.customer_id is null
      and public.normalize_phone(g.phone) = ev.phone
    )
  join public.org_organization_product q on q.organization_id = g.id
  where coalesce(q.purchase_date, q.trial_start_date, q.created_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) <= params.checked_at

  union all

  -- Fallback only when the event account has no authoritative aka_order row.
  select
    'tracking_snapshot',
    ev.account_package,
    ev.account_product_list,
    null::bigint,
    null::bigint,
    ev.account_expired_at,
    case
      when ev.account_package in ('forever', 'unlimited', 'lifetime') then 'other'
      when ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and pg_catalog.date_part('year', ev.account_expired_at) >= 2090 then 'other'
      when ev.account_created_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and (ev.account_expired_at::date - ev.account_created_at::date) >= 1500 then 'other'
      when ev.account_package ~ 'month$' then 'month'
      when ev.account_package ~ 'year$' then 'year'
      when ev.account_created_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and (ev.account_expired_at::date - ev.account_created_at::date) >= 200 then 'year'
      when ev.account_created_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at is not null
        and (ev.account_expired_at::date - ev.account_created_at::date) >= 1 then 'month'
      else 'other'
    end,
    ev.account_expired_at is not null and ev.account_expired_at >= params.checked_at,
    ev.account_expired_at is null
  from params
  cross join ev
  where (ev.account_package is not null or ev.account_expired_at is not null)
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.aka_order direct_order
      where direct_order.account_id_old = ev.account_id
    )
),
current_stats as (
  select
    count(c.source) > 0 as has_history,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(c.is_active), false) as has_active,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(c.status_unknown), false) as has_unknown,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(
      c.is_active and c.term_group = 'month'
      and c.expires_at <= params.checked_at + interval '15 days'
    ), false) as near_month,
    coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(
      c.is_active and c.term_group = 'year'
      and c.expires_at <= params.checked_at + interval '30 days'
    ), false) as near_year
  from params
  left join current_entitlements c on true
  group by params.checked_at
),
current_class as (
  select case
    when current_stats.near_month then 'monthly_expiring_15d'
    when current_stats.near_year then 'yearly_expiring_30d'
    when current_stats.has_active or current_stats.has_unknown then null
    when current_stats.has_history then 'expired'
    else 'no_package'
  end as reason
  from current_stats
),
matched as (
  select c.*
  from current_entitlements c
  cross join current_class cc
  cross join params
  where
    (cc.reason = 'monthly_expiring_15d' and c.is_active and c.term_group = 'month'
      and c.expires_at <= params.checked_at + interval '15 days')
    or
    (cc.reason = 'yearly_expiring_30d' and c.is_active and c.term_group = 'year'
      and c.expires_at <= params.checked_at + interval '30 days')
    or
    (cc.reason = 'expired' and not c.is_active and not c.status_unknown)
  order by
    case when cc.reason in ('monthly_expiring_15d', 'yearly_expiring_30d') then c.expires_at end asc nulls last,
    case when cc.reason = 'expired' then c.expires_at end desc nulls last,
    c.order_id desc nulls last,
    c.organization_product_id desc nulls last
  limit 1
)
select
  ev.id,
  ev.event_at,
  cust.id,
  cust.name,
  ev.phone,
  cust.org_staff_id_owner,
  event_class.reason,
  current_class.reason,
  matched.package_name,
  matched.product_list,
  matched.expires_at,
  case when matched.expires_at is null then null else
    pg_catalog.round(pg_catalog.date_part('epoch', matched.expires_at - params.checked_at)::numeric / 86400, 3)
  end,
  matched.source,
  matched.order_id,
  matched.organization_product_id,
  ev.account_package,
  ev.account_expired_at
from params
cross join ev
cross join cust
cross join event_class
cross join current_class
left join matched on true
where event_class.reason is not null
  and current_class.reason is not null;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_expired_priority_candidates(p_limit integer DEFAULT 105, p_owner_staff_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(customer_id bigint, order_id bigint, phone text, customer_name text, package text, product_list text, last_expiration timestamp with time zone, days_expired integer, paid_orders integer, funnel_stage_id smallint, referral_count integer, tier integer, campaigns_30d integer, login_days_30d integer, owner_staff_id bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with
params as (
  select
    greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 105), 0)::integer as result_limit,
    floor(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 105), 0) * 0.30)::integer as challenger_limit,
    floor(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 105), 0) * 0.10)::integer as repeat_limit
),
all_candidates as materialized (
  select *
  from public.get_expired_priority_candidate_context(null)
),
global_min_round as (
  select min(c.historical_crm_count) as historical_crm_count
  from all_candidates c
),
scoped as materialized (
  select c.*
  from all_candidates c
  where p_owner_staff_id is null or c.owner_staff_id = p_owner_staff_id
),
repeat_ranked as materialized (
  select
    c.*,
    row_number() over (
      order by c.renewal_priority_score desc, c.last_expiration desc, c.customer_id
    ) as repeat_rank
  from scoped c
  where c.historical_crm_count > 0
    and c.days_expired <= 365
),
challenger_pool as materialized (
  select c.*
  from scoped c
  where c.historical_crm_count = 0
    and c.days_expired <= 365

  union all

  select r.customer_id, r.candidate_source, r.order_id,
    r.org_organization_product_id, r.source_organization_id, r.phone,
    r.customer_name, r.package, r.product_list, r.last_expiration,
    r.days_expired, r.paid_cycles, r.funnel_stage_id, r.referral_count,
    r.tier, r.campaigns_30d, r.login_days_30d, r.owner_staff_id,
    r.historical_crm_count, r.renewal_priority_score, r.score_factors,
    r.crm_action, r.existing_crm_id
  from repeat_ranked r
  cross join params p
  where r.repeat_rank <= p.repeat_limit
),
challenger_selected as materialized (
  select ranked.*
  from (
    select
      c.*,
      row_number() over (
        order by c.renewal_priority_score desc, c.last_expiration desc, c.customer_id
      )::integer as pool_rank
    from challenger_pool c
  ) ranked
  cross join params p
  where ranked.pool_rank <= p.challenger_limit
),
control_selected as materialized (
  select ranked.*
  from (
    select
      c.*,
      row_number() over (
        order by
          c.tier desc,
          c.campaigns_30d desc,
          c.login_days_30d desc,
          c.last_expiration desc,
          c.customer_id
      )::integer as pool_rank
    from scoped c
    join global_min_round mr
      on mr.historical_crm_count = c.historical_crm_count
    where not exists (
      select 1 from challenger_selected x where x.customer_id = c.customer_id
    )
  ) ranked
  cross join params p
  where ranked.pool_rank <= greatest(p.result_limit - p.challenger_limit, 0)
),
interleaved as (
  select
    c.*,
    (
      10 * floor((c.pool_rank - 1)::numeric / 7)
      + (array[1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9])[(((c.pool_rank - 1) % 7) + 1)::integer]
    )::integer as hybrid_slot
  from control_selected c

  union all

  select
    c.*,
    (
      10 * floor((c.pool_rank - 1)::numeric / 3)
      + (array[4, 7, 10])[(((c.pool_rank - 1) % 3) + 1)::integer]
    )::integer as hybrid_slot
  from challenger_selected c
)
select
  i.customer_id,
  i.order_id,
  i.phone,
  i.customer_name,
  i.package,
  i.product_list,
  i.last_expiration,
  i.days_expired,
  i.paid_cycles as paid_orders,
  i.funnel_stage_id,
  i.referral_count,
  i.tier,
  i.campaigns_30d,
  i.login_days_30d,
  i.owner_staff_id
from interleaved i
order by i.hybrid_slot, i.customer_id
limit (select result_limit from params)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_frequent_login_expired_candidates_v2(p_min_login_days integer DEFAULT 8, p_limit integer DEFAULT 15)
 RETURNS TABLE(customer_id bigint, order_id bigint, account_id_old integer, phone text, order_name text, staff_id uuid, staff_manage_id_old integer, is_demo boolean, package text, product_list text, date_expiration timestamp with time zone, login_days bigint, post_expiry_login_days bigint, last_login_at timestamp with time zone, days_expired integer, phase text, nudges_30d integer, last_nudge timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
with params as materialized (
  select
    statement_timestamp() as now_ts,
    (statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date as vn_today,
    (((statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - 29)::timestamp
      at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') as window_start,
    ((((statement_timestamp() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date + 1))::timestamp
      at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') as window_end
),
latest_paid as materialized (
  select distinct on (o.customer_id)
    o.customer_id,
    o.id as order_id,
    o.account_id_old,
    o.phone,
    o.name as order_name,
    o.staff_id,
    o.staff_manage_id_old,
    o.is_demo,
    o.package,
    o.product_list,
    o.date_expiration
  from public.aka_order o
  where o.customer_id is not null
    and o.date_expiration is not null
    and coalesce(o.is_demo, false) = false
    and (
      coalesce(o.thanh_tien, 0) > 0
      or lower(btrim(coalesce(o.package, ''))) not in ('', 'demo', 'free')
    )
  order by o.customer_id, o.date_expiration desc, o.id desc
),
true_expired as materialized (
  select lp.*
  from latest_paid lp
  cross join params p
  where lp.date_expiration < p.now_ts
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.aka_order current_order
      where current_order.customer_id = lp.customer_id
        and current_order.date_expiration >= p.now_ts
        and coalesce(current_order.is_demo, false) = false
        and (
          coalesce(current_order.thanh_tien, 0) > 0
          or lower(btrim(coalesce(current_order.package, ''))) not in ('', 'demo', 'free')
        )
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.org_organization oo
      join public.org_organization_product op
        on op.organization_id = oo.id
      where oo.customer_id = lp.customer_id
        and coalesce(op.is_deleted, false) = false
        and coalesce(op.is_paid, false) = true
        and coalesce(op.is_lock, false) = false
        and (op.expiration_date is null or op.expiration_date >= p.now_ts)
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.aka_sale_order sale_order
      where sale_order.customer_id = lp.customer_id
        and sale_order.status = 'completed'
        and coalesce(sale_order.paid_at, sale_order.upgraded_at, sale_order.created_at)
              >= lp.date_expiration
    )
),
phone_unique as materialized (
  select public.normalize_phone(e.phone) as phone_norm
  from true_expired e
  where e.account_id_old is null
    and nullif(public.normalize_phone(e.phone), '') is not null
  group by public.normalize_phone(e.phone)
  having count(distinct e.customer_id) = 1
),
matched_events as materialized (
  select e.customer_id, tracking.event_timestamp
  from true_expired e
  join public.aka_tracking_app tracking
    on tracking.account_id = e.account_id_old
  cross join params p
  where e.account_id_old is not null
    and tracking.event_type = 'login_app_akabiz'
    and tracking.event_timestamp >= p.window_start
    and tracking.event_timestamp < p.window_end

  union all

  select e.customer_id, tracking.event_timestamp
  from true_expired e
  join phone_unique phone
    on phone.phone_norm = public.normalize_phone(e.phone)
  join public.aka_tracking_app tracking
    on public.normalize_phone(tracking.phone) = phone.phone_norm
  cross join params p
  where e.account_id_old is null
    and tracking.event_type = 'login_app_akabiz'
    and tracking.event_timestamp >= p.window_start
    and tracking.event_timestamp < p.window_end
),
usage_30d as materialized (
  select
    events.customer_id,
    count(distinct (events.event_timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date)::bigint
      as login_days,
    max(events.event_timestamp) as last_login_at
  from matched_events events
  group by events.customer_id
),
candidate as materialized (
  select
    expired.*,
    usage.login_days,
    coalesce((
      select count(distinct (events.event_timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date)
      from matched_events events
      where events.customer_id = expired.customer_id
        and events.event_timestamp >= expired.date_expiration
    ), 0)::bigint as post_expiry_login_days,
    usage.last_login_at,
    greatest(
      0,
      p.vn_today - (expired.date_expiration at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date
    )::integer as days_expired
  from true_expired expired
  join usage_30d usage using (customer_id)
  cross join params p
  where usage.login_days >= greatest(coalesce(p_min_login_days, 8), 8)
    and usage.last_login_at >= p.now_ts - interval '7 days'
),
guarded as materialized (
  select
    candidate.*,
    (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.aka_crm crm
      where crm.customer_id = candidate.customer_id
        and crm.crm_type_id = 16
        and crm.created_at >= p.now_ts - interval '30 days'
    ) as nudges_30d,
    (
      select max(crm.created_at)
      from public.aka_crm crm
      where crm.customer_id = candidate.customer_id
        and crm.crm_type_id = 16
        and crm.created_at >= p.now_ts - interval '30 days'
    ) as last_nudge
  from candidate
  cross join params p
  where (
      candidate.post_expiry_login_days > 0
      or (candidate.post_expiry_login_days = 0 and candidate.days_expired between 0 and 7)
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.aka_crm open_crm
      where open_crm.customer_id = candidate.customer_id
        and open_crm.crm_type_id in (4, 16, 18)
        and open_crm.cskh_completed_date is null
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.aka_crm recent_contact
      where recent_contact.customer_id = candidate.customer_id
        and recent_contact.crm_type_id in (4, 18)
        and recent_contact.cskh_completed_date >= p.now_ts - interval '7 days'
    )
),
eligible as (
  select guarded.*
  from guarded
  cross join params p
  where case
    when guarded.days_expired <= 30 then
      guarded.nudges_30d < 2
      and (guarded.last_nudge is null or guarded.last_nudge <= p.now_ts - interval '7 days')
    else
      guarded.nudges_30d < 1
      and (guarded.last_nudge is null or guarded.last_nudge <= p.now_ts - interval '30 days')
  end
)
select
  eligible.customer_id::bigint,
  eligible.order_id::bigint,
  eligible.account_id_old::integer,
  eligible.phone::text,
  eligible.order_name::text,
  eligible.staff_id::uuid,
  eligible.staff_manage_id_old::integer,
  eligible.is_demo::boolean,
  eligible.package::text,
  eligible.product_list::text,
  eligible.date_expiration::timestamptz,
  eligible.login_days::bigint,
  eligible.post_expiry_login_days::bigint,
  eligible.last_login_at::timestamptz,
  eligible.days_expired::integer,
  case when eligible.post_expiry_login_days > 0 then 'HOT' else 'WARM' end::text,
  eligible.nudges_30d::integer,
  eligible.last_nudge::timestamptz
from eligible
order by
  case when eligible.post_expiry_login_days > 0 then 0 else 1 end,
  eligible.days_expired asc,
  eligible.login_days desc,
  eligible.last_login_at desc,
  eligible.customer_id
limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 15), 0), 100);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_birthday_care_classify_v2(p_customer_id bigint, p_as_of date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_as_of date := coalesce(p_as_of, (pg_catalog.now() at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date);
  v_cfg public.aka_birthday_care_config%rowtype;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_phone text;
begin
  select * into v_cfg from public.aka_birthday_care_config where singleton;
  if p_customer_id is null then
    return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('eligible', false, 'skip_reason', 'customer_null', 'as_of_date_vn', v_as_of);
  end if;
  select public.normalize_phone(c.phone) into v_phone from public.aka_customer c where c.id = p_customer_id;
  if v_phone !~ '^0[1-9][0-9]{8}$' then v_phone := null; end if;

  with base as (
    select
      'aka_order'::text as source,
      o.id,
      o.id as order_id,
      null::bigint as organization_product_id,
      public.fn_birthday_care_product_label_v2(o.product_list) as product_name,
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(o.package), '') as package_name,
      pg_catalog.lower(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(o.package_type), '')) as package_type,
      o.duration_days,
      (coalesce(o.date_create, o.purchase_date, o.created_at) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date as starts_on,
      (o.date_expiration at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date as expires_on,
      (
        pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package_type, o.package, '')) ~ '(forever|lifetime|unlimited|vĩnh viễn|vinh vien|trọn đời)'
        or pg_catalog.date_part('year', o.date_expiration) >= 2090
      ) as is_lifetime,
      (
        coalesce(o.is_demo, false)
        or pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(o.package_type, o.package, '')) ~ '(demo|trial|free|dùng thử|dung thu|miễn phí|mien phi)'
      ) as is_demo,
      coalesce(o.is_active, false) as source_enabled,
      o.thanh_tien as amount,
      o.username,
      o.customer_id as owner_customer_id,
      greatest(o.sql_sync_at, o.date_update_package, o.date_last_update, o.date_create, o.created_at) as source_updated_at
    from public.aka_order o
    where (o.customer_id = p_customer_id
           or (v_phone is not null and o.customer_id is distinct from p_customer_id and public.normalize_phone(o.phone) = v_phone))
      and coalesce(o.is_deleted, false) = false

    union all

    select
      'org_organization_product',
      op.id,
      null::bigint,
      op.id,
      coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.product_name), ''), prod.name, public.fn_birthday_care_product_label_v2(prod.code)),
      coalesce(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.package_name), ''), nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.package_type), '')),
      pg_catalog.lower(nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(op.package_type), '')),
      op.duration_days,
      (coalesce(op.purchase_date, op.trial_start_date, op.created_at) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date,
      (op.expiration_date at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date,
      (
        pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(op.package_type, '') || ' ' || coalesce(op.package_name, '')) ~ '(forever|lifetime|unlimited|vĩnh viễn|vinh vien|trọn đời)'
        or pg_catalog.date_part('year', op.expiration_date) >= 2090
        or coalesce(op.duration_days, 0) >= 5000
      ),
      (
        not coalesce(op.is_paid, false)
        or pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(op.package_type, '') || ' ' || coalesce(op.package_name, '')) ~ '(demo|trial|free|dùng thử|dung thu|miễn phí|mien phi)'
      ),
      (not coalesce(op.is_lock, false)),
      null::numeric,
      null::text,
      org.customer_id,
      greatest(op.updated_at, op.purchase_date, op.trial_start_date, op.created_at)
    from public.org_organization org
    join public.org_organization_product op on op.organization_id = org.id
    left join public.org_product prod on prod.id = op.product_id
    where (org.customer_id = p_customer_id
           or (v_phone is not null and org.customer_id is distinct from p_customer_id and public.normalize_phone(org.phone) = v_phone))
      and coalesce(op.is_deleted, false) = false
  ),
  ent as (
    select b.*,
      not b.is_demo and not b.is_lifetime as is_paid,
      case
        when b.is_lifetime then 'lifetime'
        when b.is_demo then 'demo'
        when b.package_type in ('year','2year','3year','4year') then 'yearly'
        when b.package_type in ('month','1_month','2month','3month','6month') then 'monthly'
        when b.duration_days is not null then case when b.duration_days >= 300 then 'yearly' else 'monthly' end
        when b.expires_on is not null and b.starts_on is not null and b.expires_on - b.starts_on >= 300 then 'yearly'
        else 'monthly'
      end as kind,
      (b.is_lifetime or (b.expires_on is not null and b.expires_on >= v_as_of)) as is_active,
      case when b.expires_on is null then null else b.expires_on - v_as_of end as days_left
    from base b
    where b.starts_on is null or b.starts_on <= v_as_of
  ),
  ent2 as (
    select e.*,
      case e.kind when 'yearly' then v_cfg.yearly_window_days when 'monthly' then v_cfg.monthly_window_days else null end as window_days
    from ent e
  ),
  stats as (
    select
      count(*)::int as history_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_paid)::int as paid_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_demo)::int as demo_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_active)::int as active_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_active and is_paid)::int as active_paid_count,
      count(*) filter (where is_active and is_demo)::int as active_demo_count,
      coalesce(pg_catalog.bool_or(is_active and is_lifetime), false) as lifetime_active,
      count(*) filter (where not is_active and expires_on is null and not is_lifetime)::int as expiration_missing_count,
      min(starts_on) filter (where is_paid) as first_paid_on,
      max(starts_on) filter (where is_paid) as last_paid_on,
      sum(amount) filter (where is_paid) as total_paid_amount,
      max(expires_on) filter (where not is_lifetime) as latest_expires_on,
      pg_catalog.string_agg(distinct product_name, ', ') as products,
      max(source_updated_at) as entitlement_watermark
    from ent2
  ),
  payment as (
    select max(p.paid_at) as last_paid_at
    from (
      select coalesce(so.paid_at, so.upgraded_at, so.updated_at, so.created_at) as paid_at
      from public.aka_sale_order so
      where so.customer_id = p_customer_id
        and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(so.status, '')) in ('paid','completed','success','confirmed')
      union all
      select coalesce(po.paid_at, po.upgraded_at, po.updated_at, po.created_at)
      from public.aka_payment_order po
      where po.customer_id = p_customer_id
        and pg_catalog.lower(coalesce(po.status, '')) in ('paid','completed','success','confirmed')
    ) p
    where p.paid_at >= (v_as_of - 90)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'
      and p.paid_at < ((v_as_of + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')
  ),
  in_window as (
    select e.* from ent2 e
    where e.is_active and e.is_paid and not e.is_lifetime
      and e.days_left is not null and e.window_days is not null and e.days_left <= e.window_days
    order by e.days_left asc, e.expires_on asc, e.id desc
    limit 1
  ),
  latest_expired as (
    select e.* from ent2 e
    where not e.is_active and e.expires_on is not null and not e.is_lifetime
    order by e.expires_on desc, e.is_paid desc, e.id desc
    limit 1
  ),
  decision as (
    select
      s.*,
      case when w.id is not null then pg_catalog.to_jsonb(w)
           when s.active_paid_count = 0 and s.active_demo_count = 0 and not s.lifetime_active then pg_catalog.to_jsonb(x)
           else null end as selected_row,
      case
        when s.history_count = 0 then 'never_purchased'
        when s.lifetime_active then 'lifetime_active'
        when w.id is not null then case w.kind when 'yearly' then 'yearly_le_' || v_cfg.yearly_window_days else 'monthly_le_' || v_cfg.monthly_window_days end
        when s.active_paid_count > 0 then 'active_outside_window'
        when s.active_demo_count > 0 then 'demo_active'
        when x.id is null then 'expiration_missing'
        when (v_as_of - x.expires_on) <= v_cfg.expired_window_days then case when x.is_paid then 'expired_paid_le_' || v_cfg.expired_window_days else 'expired_demo_le_' || v_cfg.expired_window_days end
        else 'expired_gt_' || v_cfg.expired_window_days
      end as rule,
      case
        when s.history_count = 0 then null
        when s.lifetime_active then null
        when w.id is not null then true
        when s.active_paid_count > 0 then null
        when s.active_demo_count > 0 then null
        when x.id is null then null
        when (v_as_of - x.expires_on) <= v_cfg.expired_window_days then true
        else null
      end as eligible_flag
    from stats s
    left join in_window w on true
    left join latest_expired x on true
  ),
  decision2 as (
    select d.*, pm.last_paid_at,
      (
        pm.last_paid_at is not null
        and (s2.entitlement_watermark is null or pm.last_paid_at > s2.entitlement_watermark + interval '1 hour')
        -- thanh toán mới hơn dữ liệu gói và KHÔNG thấy gói nào còn hạn đủ xa sau ngày trả tiền ⇒ đơn chưa đồng bộ
        and not exists (
          select 1 from ent2 e
          where e.is_active
            and (e.is_lifetime or e.expires_on >= (pm.last_paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date + 20)
        )
      ) as payment_pending_sync
    from decision d cross join payment pm cross join stats s2
  )
  select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'as_of_date_vn', v_as_of,
    'eligible', coalesce(d.eligible_flag, false) and not d.payment_pending_sync,
    'rule', case when d.payment_pending_sync then 'payment_pending_sync' else d.rule end,
    'rule_before_payment_check', d.rule,
    'payment_pending_sync', d.payment_pending_sync,
    'last_paid_at', d.last_paid_at,
    'entitlement_watermark', d.entitlement_watermark,
    'skip_reason', case when d.payment_pending_sync then 'payment_pending_sync' when coalesce(d.eligible_flag, false) then null else d.rule end,
    'segment', case
      when d.rule like 'yearly_le_%' then 'renew_yearly'
      when d.rule like 'monthly_le_%' then 'renew_monthly'
      when d.rule like 'expired_paid_%' then 'winback_paid'
      when d.rule like 'expired_demo_%' then 'convert_demo'
      else null end,
    'stats', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'history_count', d.history_count, 'paid_count', d.paid_count, 'demo_count', d.demo_count,
      'active_count', d.active_count, 'active_paid_count', d.active_paid_count, 'active_demo_count', d.active_demo_count,
      'lifetime_active', d.lifetime_active, 'first_paid_on', d.first_paid_on, 'last_paid_on', d.last_paid_on,
      'total_paid_amount', d.total_paid_amount, 'latest_expires_on', d.latest_expires_on, 'products', d.products
    ),
    'selected', case
      when d.selected_row is null then null
      else (d.selected_row - 'source_enabled' - 'source_updated_at')
        || pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
             'days_expired', case when (d.selected_row ->> 'expires_on')::date < v_as_of then v_as_of - (d.selected_row ->> 'expires_on')::date else null end,
             'account_locked', not coalesce((d.selected_row ->> 'source_enabled')::boolean, true))
      end,
    'entitlements', (
      select coalesce(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(
        pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('source', e.source, 'id', e.id, 'product_name', e.product_name, 'package_name', e.package_name,
          'package_type', e.package_type, 'kind', e.kind, 'starts_on', e.starts_on, 'expires_on', e.expires_on,
          'days_left', e.days_left, 'is_active', e.is_active, 'is_paid', e.is_paid, 'is_demo', e.is_demo,
          'is_lifetime', e.is_lifetime, 'amount', e.amount, 'account_locked', not e.source_enabled, 'username', e.username, 'customer_id', e.owner_customer_id)
        order by e.is_active desc, e.expires_on desc nulls last, e.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select * from ent2 order by is_active desc, expires_on desc nulls last, id desc limit 8) e
    )
  ) into v_result
  from decision2 d;

  return v_result;
end;

p_limit integer DEFAULT 50
p_job_id uuid, p_claim_token uuid, p_promotion_id bigint, p_promotion_match_key text, p_ai_log_id bigint, p_message_sha256 text, p_expected_content text DEFAULT NULL::text
