definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_chat_followup_insert_verified_v2(p_day date, p_ai_node_ids text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_prep      jsonb;
  v_chuoi     integer := 0;
  v_moc       integer := 0;
  v_filtered  integer := 0;
  v_reasons   jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_groups    jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  r           record;
  f           jsonb;
  v_final     bigint;
  v_name      text;
  v_phone     text;
  v_owner     bigint;
  v_org       bigint;
  v_prio      integer;
  v_group     text;
  v_label     text;
  v_pancake   text;
  v_ins       integer;
  v_key       text;
  v_crm_first bigint;
  v_crm_all   bigint[];
begin
  if p_day is null then
    raise exception 'p_day khong duoc null';
  end if;

  if coalesce(cardinality(p_ai_node_ids), 0) = 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('day', p_day, 'chains_created', 0, 'milestones_created', 0,
                              'filtered_out', 0, 'filter_reasons', '{}'::jsonb);
  end if;

  -- Chay lai toan bo bo loc truoc AI ngay truoc khi INSERT (dong race).
  v_prep := public.fn_chat_followup_prepare_v2(p_day, false, false);

  for r in
    with candidate as (
      select *
      from jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(v_prep -> 'candidates', '[]'::jsonb)) as c(
        gom_id uuid,
        contact_id uuid,
        conversation_id text,
        customer_id bigint,
        customer_name text,
        customer_phone text,
        bot_intent text,
        bot_confidence numeric,
        question_content text,
        product_id bigint,
        tier text,
        label text,
        priority integer,
        channel_id bigint,
        offsets_day integer[],
        owner_id bigint,
        pancake_url text,
        purchase_status text,
        last_package_expiration timestamptz
      )
    ),
    latest_ai as (
      select distinct on (l.node_id)
             l.node_id,
             (l.sanitized_request ->> 'day')::date as day,
             (l.sanitized_request ->> 'customer_id')::bigint as customer_id,
             (l.sanitized_request ->> 'gom_id')::uuid as gom_id,
             l.sanitized_response as verdict,
             l.created_at as ai_at
      from public.ai_log l
      where l.using_code = 'chat_followup_verify_intent'
        and l.block_name = 'chat-followup-precreate-v2'
        and l.status = 'success'
        and l.node_id = any(p_ai_node_ids)
      order by l.node_id, l.created_at desc, l.id desc
    )
    select c.*, a.node_id, a.verdict, a.ai_at
    from candidate c
    join latest_ai a
      on a.day = p_day
     and a.customer_id = c.customer_id
     and a.gom_id = c.gom_id
    where jsonb_typeof(a.verdict -> 'co_nhu_cau') = 'boolean'
      and a.verdict -> 'co_nhu_cau' = 'true'::jsonb
    order by c.customer_id
  loop
    -- ===== BO LOC SAU AI (ap dung that: cap nhat aka_customer / contacts / gop trung) =====
    f := public.fn_chat_followup_post_ai_filter_v1(
           p_day, r.customer_id, r.contact_id, r.conversation_id, r.gom_id, true);

    if not coalesce((f ->> 'passed')::boolean, false) then
      v_filtered := v_filtered + 1;
      v_key := coalesce(f ->> 'reason', 'unknown');
      v_reasons := v_reasons || jsonb_build_object(v_key, coalesce((v_reasons ->> v_key)::integer, 0) + 1);
      continue;
    end if;

    v_final   := coalesce((f ->> 'final_customer_id')::bigint, r.customer_id);
    v_group   := f ->> 'customer_group';
    v_label   := coalesce(f ->> 'group_label', v_group);
    v_owner   := coalesce((f ->> 'owner_id')::bigint, r.owner_id);
    v_pancake := coalesce(f ->> 'pancake_url', r.pancake_url);

    select c.name, coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.phone), ''), f ->> 'phone')
      into v_name, v_phone
      from public.aka_customer c where c.id = v_final;
    v_name := coalesce(v_name, r.customer_name);

    select s.organization_id into v_org from public.org_staff s where s.id = v_owner;

    -- het han / sap het han -> uu tien hon (prepare da tru 5 neu had_paid_package; tranh tru 2 lan)
    v_prio := r.priority - case
                when r.purchase_status = 'chua_mua' and v_group in ('het_han_su_dung', 'con_han_sap_het') then 5
                else 0 end;

    with ins as (
      insert into public.aka_crm (
        customer_id, customer_name, customer_phone,
        crm_type_id, priority, org_staff_owner_id, organization_id, created_by,
        cskh_due_date, note, task_note, pancake_url,
        suggested_channel_id, suggested_content,
        interest_date, interest_product_ids, is_read,
        source_order_id, source_type,
        gen_status, gen_agent, gen_at, gen_meta
      )
      select v_final,
             v_name,
             v_phone,
             19,
             v_prio,
             v_owner,
             v_org,
             v_owner,
             (
               (
                 case
                   when extract(dow from p_day + off.day_offset) = 0
                   then p_day + off.day_offset + 1
                   else p_day + off.day_offset
                 end
               ) + time '08:30'
             ) at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
             format('Ho tro kh [%s] %s sau %s ngay', v_label, r.label, off.day_offset),
             format('[%s] %s', r.bot_intent, left(coalesce(r.question_content, ''), 300)),
             v_pancake,
             r.channel_id,
             (
               select t.content
               from public.auto_content_templates t
               join public.auto_content_groups gr on gr.id = t.group_id
               where gr.is_active
                 and not coalesce(gr.is_delete, false)
                 and not coalesce(t.is_delete, false)
                 and gr.crm_type_ids @> array[19::bigint]
                 and t.content_type_id = 59
               order by gr.stt, t.id
               limit 1
             ),
             p_day,
             case when r.product_id is null then '{}'::bigint[] else array[r.product_id] end,
             false,
             v_final,
             format('chat_followup:%s:%s', to_char(p_day, 'YYYYMMDD'), off.seq_no),
             'scheduled',
             'chat-followup-v2',
             now(),
             jsonb_build_object(
               'chain', r.tier,
               'seq', off.seq_no,
               'offset', off.day_offset,
               'd0', p_day::text,
               'intent', r.bot_intent,
               'conf', r.bot_confidence,
               'gom_id', r.gom_id::text,
               'mua', r.purchase_status,
               'han_cuoi', r.last_package_expiration,
               'ai_node_id', r.node_id,
               'ai_nhu_cau', true,
               'ai_tier', r.verdict ->> 'tier',
               'ai_confidence', r.verdict -> 'confidence',
               'ai_evidence', r.verdict ->> 'evidence',
               'ai_reason', r.verdict ->> 'reason',
               'ai_at', r.ai_at,
               'filter', jsonb_build_object(
                 'group', v_group,
                 'days_left', f -> 'days_left',
                 'phone_source', f ->> 'phone_source',
                 'owner_source', f ->> 'owner_source',
                 'input_customer_id', r.customer_id,
                 'final_customer_id', v_final
               )
             )
      from unnest(r.offsets_day) with ordinality as off(day_offset, seq_no)
      on conflict (source_order_id, source_type)
        where source_order_id is not null
        do nothing
      returning id, (gen_meta ->> 'seq')::integer as seq_no
    )
    select count(*), min(id) filter (where seq_no = 1), array_agg(id order by seq_no)
      into v_ins, v_crm_first, v_crm_all
      from ins;

    -- ghi nguoc CRM ve dung tin nhan (gom) co intent da kich hoat chuoi
    if v_ins > 0 and r.gom_id is not null then
      update public.message_gom g
         set crm_id  = coalesce(g.crm_id, v_crm_first, v_crm_all[1]),
             crm_ids = coalesce(g.crm_ids, '{}'::bigint[]) || v_crm_all
       where g.id = r.gom_id;
    end if;

    if v_ins > 0 then
      v_chuoi := v_chuoi + 1;
      v_moc := v_moc + v_ins;
      v_key := coalesce(v_group, 'unknown');
      v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(v_key, coalesce((v_groups ->> v_key)::integer, 0) + 1);
    end if;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'day', p_day,
    'chains_created', v_chuoi,
    'milestones_created', v_moc,
    'filtered_out', v_filtered,
    'filter_reasons', v_reasons,
    'groups', v_groups
  );
end
$function$

arguments: p_day date, p_customer_id bigint, p_contact_id uuid, p_conversation_id text, p_gom_id uuid, p_apply boolean DEFAULT false
p_day date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date, p_tao_khach_moi boolean DEFAULT true, p_bo_qua_lich_hien_co boolean DEFAULT false
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_chat_followup_prepare_v2(p_day date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date, p_tao_khach_moi boolean DEFAULT true, p_bo_qua_lich_hien_co boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_dau timestamptz := (p_day::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');
  v_cuoi timestamptz := ((p_day + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');
  v_intents text[] := array[
    'A1_ASK_PRICE','C2_PURCHASE_UPGRADE','C4_RENEWAL','C5_ASK_DISCOUNT','D5_REQUEST_CALL','B4_ASK_DATA',
    'A5_REQUEST_TRIAL',
    'A2_ASK_POLICY','A3_ASK_PRODUCT_INFO','A4_ASK_LIMIT','B1_HOW_TO_USE','B2_HOW_TO_SETUP','B3_REQUEST_DOCS','C7_REFERRAL','E1A_GREETING_RETURN'
  ];
  v_khach_tao_moi integer := 0;
  r_uv record;
  v_up jsonb;
  v_result jsonb;
  v_renew integer := coalesce((select f.renewal_window_days from public.aka_chat_followup_filter_config f where f.id = 1), 15);
begin
  if p_day is null then
    raise exception 'p_day khong duoc null';
  end if;

  if p_tao_khach_moi then
    -- (HÀM CHUNG) tạo hồ sơ khách chat chưa có SĐT qua public.fn_upsert_aka_customer_v1 (khóa zalo_uid + pancake_url), tự gắn contacts.customer_id
    v_khach_tao_moi := 0;
    for r_uv in
      select distinct on (g.contact_id)
             g.contact_id,
             ct.name,
             ct.zalo_name,
             ct.uid,
             ct.conversion_id,
             ct.shop_id,
             (
               select sh.pancake_page_id
               from public.shops sh
               where sh.id::text = ct.shop_id
             ) as page_id,
             (
               select g2.answer_org_staff_id
               from public.message_gom g2
               where g2.contact_id = g.contact_id
                 and g2.answer_org_staff_id is not null
               order by g2.created_at desc
               limit 1
             ) as owner_id
      from public.message_gom g
      join public.contacts ct on ct.id = g.contact_id
      where g.created_at >= v_dau
        and g.created_at < v_cuoi
        and g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
        and coalesce(g.bot_confidence, 0) >= 70
        and g.bot_intent = any(v_intents)
        and g.aka_customer_id is null
        and ct.customer_id is null
        and coalesce(g.phone, ct.phone, '') = ''
        and coalesce(ct.is_group, false) = false
        and coalesce(ct.name, ct.zalo_name, '') <> ''
      order by g.contact_id, g.created_at desc
    loop
      v_up := public.fn_upsert_aka_customer_v1(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'zalo_uid', r_uv.uid,
        'pancake_url', case when r_uv.page_id is not null and r_uv.conversion_id is not null then format('https://pancake.vn/%s?c_id=%s', r_uv.page_id, r_uv.conversion_id) end,
        'name', coalesce(r_uv.name, r_uv.zalo_name), 'name_zalo', r_uv.zalo_name,
        'channel', 'chat', 'org_staff_id', r_uv.owner_id, 'contact_id', r_uv.contact_id, 'is_split_exempt', true,
        'creation_path', 'chat-followup-v2',
        'custom_fields', jsonb_build_object('nguon', 'chat-followup-v2', 'contact_id', r_uv.contact_id::text, 'contact_uid', r_uv.uid,
                                             'conversion_id', r_uv.conversion_id, 'shop_id', r_uv.shop_id, 'tao_ngay', p_day::text)
      )));
      if coalesce((v_up ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) and coalesce((v_up ->> 'is_new')::boolean, false) then v_khach_tao_moi := v_khach_tao_moi + 1; end if;
    end loop;
  end if;

  with rule(tier, nhan, rank_no, prio, kenh, intent_codes, offsets_day) as (
    values
      (
        'BUY'::text,
        'hoi gia/mua'::text,
        3,
        20,
        10::bigint,
        array['A1_ASK_PRICE','C2_PURCHASE_UPGRADE','C4_RENEWAL','C5_ASK_DISCOUNT','D5_REQUEST_CALL','B4_ASK_DATA']::text[],
        array[1,3,7,14]::integer[]
      ),
      (
        'TRIAL'::text,
        'dung thu'::text,
        2,
        25,
        8::bigint,
        array['A5_REQUEST_TRIAL']::text[],
        array[1,3,7]::integer[]
      ),
      (
        'INTEREST'::text,
        'quan tam'::text,
        1,
        30,
        8::bigint,
        array['A2_ASK_POLICY','A3_ASK_PRODUCT_INFO','A4_ASK_LIMIT','B1_HOW_TO_USE','B2_HOW_TO_SETUP','B3_REQUEST_DOCS','C7_REFERRAL','E1A_GREETING_RETURN']::text[],
        array[1,3]::integer[]
      )
  ),
  gom as (
    select g.id as gom_id,
           g.contact_id,
           g.conversation_id,
           g.bot_intent,
           g.bot_confidence,
           g.created_at,
           g.question_content,
           g.product_id,
           coalesce(
             g.aka_customer_id,
             ct.customer_id,
             (
               select c.id
               from public.aka_customer c
               where public.normalize_phone(c.phone) = public.normalize_phone(g.phone)
               order by c.created_at desc nulls last
               limit 1
             )
           ) as customer_id
    from public.message_gom g
    left join public.contacts ct on ct.id = g.contact_id
    where g.created_at >= v_dau
      and g.created_at < v_cuoi
      and g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
      and g.bot_intent is not null
  ),
  bao_tt as (
    select distinct coalesce(
             g.aka_customer_id,
             ct.customer_id,
             (
               select c.id
               from public.aka_customer c
               where public.normalize_phone(c.phone) = public.normalize_phone(g.phone)
               order by c.created_at desc nulls last
               limit 1
             )
           ) as customer_id
    from public.message_gom g
    left join public.contacts ct on ct.id = g.contact_id
    where g.bot_intent = 'C1_CONFIRM_PAYMENT'
      and coalesce(g.bot_confidence, 0) >= 70
      and g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
      and g.created_at >= v_dau - interval '14 days'
      and g.created_at < v_cuoi
  ),
  matched as (
    select gom.*,
           r.tier,
           r.nhan,
           r.rank_no,
           r.prio,
           r.kenh,
           r.offsets_day
    from gom
    join rule r on gom.bot_intent = any(r.intent_codes)
    where coalesce(gom.bot_confidence, 0) >= 70
      and gom.customer_id is not null
  ),
  best as (
    select distinct on (customer_id) *
    from matched
    order by customer_id, rank_no desc, bot_confidence desc, created_at desc
  ),
  decision as (
    select b.gom_id,
           b.contact_id,
           b.conversation_id,
           b.bot_intent,
           b.bot_confidence,
           b.question_content,
           b.product_id,
           b.customer_id,
           b.tier,
           b.nhan,
           b.prio,
           b.kenh,
           b.offsets_day,
           c.name as customer_name,
           c.phone as customer_phone,
           coalesce(
             c.org_staff_id_owner,
             (
               select s.id
               from public.org_staff s
               where s.is_active
                 and s.is_data_division
               order by (
                 select count(*)
                 from public.aka_crm r2
                 where r2.org_staff_owner_id = s.id
                   and r2.cskh_completed_date is null
               ), s.id
               limit 1
             )
           ) as owner_id,
           exists (
             select 1
             from public.aka_order ao
             where ao.customer_id = b.customer_id
               and coalesce(ao.is_active, true) = true
               and ao.date_expiration > now() + make_interval(days => v_renew)
               and coalesce(ao.is_demo, false) = false
               and lower(coalesce(ao.package, '')) <> 'demo'
               and nullif(btrim(coalesce(ao.product_list, '')), '') is not null
               and btrim(coalesce(ao.product_list, '')) <> '[]'
           ) as active_aka_order,
           exists (
             select 1
             from public.org_organization_product op
             join public.org_organization org on org.id = op.organization_id
             where org.customer_id = b.customer_id
               and coalesce(op.is_deleted, false) = false
               and op.is_paid
               and coalesce(op.is_lock, false) = false
               and op.expiration_date > now() + make_interval(days => v_renew)
           ) as active_org_product,
           (
             exists (
               select 1
               from public.aka_order ao
               where ao.customer_id = b.customer_id
                 and coalesce(ao.is_demo, false) = false
                 and lower(coalesce(ao.package, '')) <> 'demo'
                 and nullif(btrim(coalesce(ao.product_list, '')), '') is not null
                 and btrim(coalesce(ao.product_list, '')) <> '[]'
             )
             or exists (
               select 1
               from public.org_organization_product op
               join public.org_organization org on org.id = op.organization_id
               where org.customer_id = b.customer_id
                 and coalesce(op.is_deleted, false) = false
                 and op.is_paid
             )
           ) as had_paid_package,
           greatest(
             (
               select max(ao.date_expiration)
               from public.aka_order ao
               where ao.customer_id = b.customer_id
                 and coalesce(ao.is_demo, false) = false
                 and lower(coalesce(ao.package, '')) <> 'demo'
             ),
             (
               select max(op.expiration_date)
               from public.org_organization_product op
               join public.org_organization org on org.id = op.organization_id
               where org.customer_id = b.customer_id
                 and coalesce(op.is_deleted, false) = false
                 and op.is_paid
             )
           ) as last_package_expiration,
           (b.customer_id in (select bt.customer_id from bao_tt bt where bt.customer_id is not null)) as bao_thanh_toan,
           exists (
             select 1
             from public.aka_crm cr
             where cr.customer_id = b.customer_id
               and cr.cskh_completed_date is null
               and cr.cskh_due_date > v_dau
           ) as dang_co_lich,
           (
             select format('https://pancake.vn/%s?c_id=%s', sh.pancake_page_id, ct2.conversion_id)
             from public.contacts ct2
             join public.shops sh on sh.id::text = ct2.shop_id
             where ct2.id = b.contact_id
               and sh.pancake_page_id is not null
               and ct2.conversion_id is not null
           ) as pancake_url
    from best b
    join public.aka_customer c on c.id = b.customer_id
  ),
  decided as (
    select d.*,
           (d.active_aka_order or d.active_org_product) as active_package,
           (
             not (d.active_aka_order or d.active_org_product)
             and not d.bao_thanh_toan
             and (p_bo_qua_lich_hien_co or not d.dang_co_lich)
           ) as eligible
    from decision d
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
           'day', p_day,
           'customers_created', v_khach_tao_moi,
           'matched_customers', count(*)::integer,
           'excluded_active_package', count(*) filter (where active_package)::integer,
           'excluded_active_aka_order', count(*) filter (where active_aka_order)::integer,
           'excluded_active_org_product', count(*) filter (where active_org_product)::integer,
           'excluded_payment_confirm', count(*) filter (where not active_package and bao_thanh_toan)::integer,
           'excluded_existing_schedule', count(*) filter (
             where not active_package and not bao_thanh_toan and dang_co_lich and not p_bo_qua_lich_hien_co
           )::integer,
           'candidate_count', count(*) filter (where eligible)::integer,
           'candidates', coalesce(
             jsonb_agg(
               jsonb_build_object(
                 'gom_id', gom_id,
                 'contact_id', contact_id,
                 'conversation_id', conversation_id,
                 'customer_id', customer_id,
                 'customer_name', customer_name,
                 'customer_phone', customer_phone,
                 'bot_intent', bot_intent,
                 'bot_confidence', bot_confidence,
                 'question_content', left(coalesce(question_content, ''), 500),
                 'product_id', product_id,
                 'tier', tier,
                 'label', nhan,
                 'priority', case when had_paid_package then prio - 5 else prio end,
                 'channel_id', kenh,
                 'offsets_day', offsets_day,
                 'owner_id', owner_id,
                 'pancake_url', pancake_url,
                 'purchase_status', case when had_paid_package then 'het_han' else 'chua_mua' end,
                 'last_package_expiration', last_package_expiration
               )
               order by customer_id
             ) filter (where eligible),
             '[]'::jsonb
           )
         )
  into v_result
  from decided;

  return coalesce(
    v_result,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'day', p_day,
      'customers_created', v_khach_tao_moi,
      'matched_customers', 0,
      'excluded_active_package', 0,
      'excluded_active_aka_order', 0,
      'excluded_active_org_product', 0,
      'excluded_payment_confirm', 0,
      'excluded_existing_schedule', 0,
      'candidate_count', 0,
      'candidates', '[]'::jsonb
    )
  );
end
$function$

arguments: p_ep boolean DEFAULT false
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_context_chay_dem(p_ep boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  s record; r record;
  v_src public.context_nguon_thu_thap%rowtype;
  v_now_local timestamp; v_start timestamptz; v_kq jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_bu_g int; v_bu_z int; v_th int; v_lk int; v_don int; v_trung jsonb;
begin
  for s in select * from public.context_cai_dat_to_chuc where is_active loop
    v_now_local := now() at time zone s.mui_gio;
    continue when not p_ep and (v_now_local::time < s.gio_tong_hop_dem or coalesce(s.tong_hop_dem_gan_nhat_ngay >= v_now_local::date, false));
    v_start := date_trunc('day', v_now_local) at time zone s.mui_gio;
    v_bu_g := 0; v_bu_z := 0; v_th := 0; v_don := 0; v_trung := null;

    -- 1) Tài khoản Zalo đã nối Pancake: tin đã vào message_gom nên bỏ qua ở chat_zalo
    v_src := null;
    select n.* into v_src from public.context_nguon_thu_thap n
     where n.organization_id = s.organization_id and n.bang_nguon = 'public.chat_zalo_message' and n.account_id is null;
    if v_src.id is not null and coalesce((v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin ->> 'tu_dong_cap_nhat_trung_pancake')::boolean, false) then
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x), '[]'::jsonb) into v_trung from (
        select ao.id as x
          from public.chat_zalo_account_organization ao
          join public.chat_zalo_account a on a.id = ao.chat_zalo_account_id
         where ao.organization_id = s.organization_id
           and a.zalo_id in (select split_part(m.conversation_id, '_', 3)
                               from public.message_gom m
                               join public.context_nguon_thu_thap g on g.organization_id = s.organization_id and g.bang_nguon = 'public.message_gom' and g.account_id = m.account_id
                              where m.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' and m.conversation_id like 'pzl_u_%')
        union
        select (e #>> '{}')::bigint from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids_co_dinh', '[]'::jsonb)) e
      ) t;
      update public.context_nguon_thu_thap set dieu_kien_loc_tin = jsonb_set(dieu_kien_loc_tin, '{bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids}', v_trung)
       where id = v_src.id and dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids' is distinct from v_trung;
      v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin := jsonb_set(v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin, '{bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids}', v_trung);
    end if;

    -- 1b) Nối lại hồ sơ với aka_customer khi contact được gán khách hàng sau lúc tạo hồ sơ
    v_lk := public.fn_context_dong_bo_lien_ket_aka(s.organization_id);

    -- 2a) Quét bù message_gom: tin khách hôm nay mà hồ sơ chưa đọc tới và không có việc đang chờ
    for r in
      select distinct on (m.contact_id) m.id
        from public.message_gom m
        join public.context_nguon_thu_thap g on g.organization_id = s.organization_id and g.bang_nguon = 'public.message_gom' and g.account_id = m.account_id and g.is_active
       where m.created_at >= v_start and m.contact_id is not null and coalesce(btrim(m.question_content), '') <> ''
         and coalesce(m.conversation_id, '') not like 'pzl_g_%'
         and not exists (
           select 1 from public.context_khach_hang_ma km
             join public.context_khach_hang kh on kh.id = public.fn_context_ho_so_chinh(km.khach_hang_id)
            where km.organization_id = s.organization_id and km.loai_ma = 'contact' and km.gia_tri = m.contact_id::text
              and (kh.la_noi_bo or kh.da_doc_den_luc >= coalesce(m.question_last_at, m.question_first_at, m.created_at)
                   or exists (select 1 from public.context_lan_thu_thap p where p.khach_hang_id = kh.id and p.status in ('pending', 'processing'))))
       order by m.contact_id, m.created_at desc
    loop
      if public.fn_context_xep_hang('message_gom', r.id::text, 'quet_bu') is not null then v_bu_g := v_bu_g + 1; end if;
    end loop;

    -- 2b) Quét bù chat_zalo: hội thoại cá nhân có tin khách hôm nay chưa được đọc
    if v_src.id is not null and v_src.is_active then
      for r in
        select c.id as conv_id,
               (select m.id from public.chat_zalo_message m
                 where m.organization_id = s.organization_id and m.chat_zalo_conversation_id = c.id and m.direction = 'incoming'
                   and coalesce(btrim(m.content_text), '') <> '' and not m.is_recalled and m.deleted_at is null and m.deletion_scope is null
                 order by m.zalo_sent_at desc nulls last, m.id desc limit 1) as msg_id
          from public.chat_zalo_conversation c
          join public.chat_zalo_account_conversation ac on ac.id = c.chat_zalo_account_conversation_id and ac.conversation_type = 'user'
         where c.organization_id = s.organization_id and c.last_incoming_at >= v_start
           and not (coalesce(v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids', '[]'::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(c.chat_zalo_account_organization_id))
           and not exists (
             select 1 from public.context_khach_hang_ma km
               join public.context_khach_hang kh on kh.id = public.fn_context_ho_so_chinh(km.khach_hang_id)
              where km.organization_id = s.organization_id and km.loai_ma = 'chat_zalo_conversation' and km.gia_tri = c.id::text
                and (kh.la_noi_bo or kh.da_doc_den_luc >= c.last_incoming_at
                     or exists (select 1 from public.context_lan_thu_thap p where p.khach_hang_id = kh.id and p.status in ('pending', 'processing'))))
      loop
        if r.msg_id is not null and public.fn_context_xep_hang('chat_zalo_message', r.msg_id::text, 'quet_bu') is not null then v_bu_z := v_bu_z + 1; end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    -- 3) Tổng hợp hồ sơ: chạy sau 20 phút để việc trích thông tin vừa xếp hàng xong trước
    insert into public.context_lan_thu_thap (organization_id, khach_hang_id, ly_do_chay, status, due_at)
    select s.organization_id, k.id, 'tong_hop_dem', 'pending', now() + interval '20 minutes'
      from public.context_khach_hang k
     where k.organization_id = s.organization_id and not k.la_noi_bo and k.gop_vao_khach_hang_id is null
       and (k.can_tong_hop_lai or exists (select 1 from public.context_lan_thu_thap p
                                           where p.khach_hang_id = k.id and p.status in ('pending', 'processing') and p.ly_do_chay <> 'tong_hop_dem'))
    on conflict (khach_hang_id, ly_do_chay) where status = 'pending' do nothing;
    get diagnostics v_th = row_count;

    -- 4) Xóa kết quả AI thô quá hạn lưu
    update public.context_lan_thu_thap set ket_qua_ai = null
     where organization_id = s.organization_id and ket_qua_ai is not null
       and completed_at < now() - make_interval(days => s.so_ngay_luu_ket_qua_ai);
    get diagnostics v_don = row_count;

    update public.context_cai_dat_to_chuc set tong_hop_dem_gan_nhat_ngay = v_now_local::date where organization_id = s.organization_id;
    v_kq := v_kq || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('organization_id', s.organization_id, 'quet_bu_message_gom', v_bu_g,
              'quet_bu_chat_zalo', v_bu_z, 'noi_lai_aka', v_lk, 'tong_hop', v_th, 'xoa_ket_qua_ai', v_don, 'tai_khoan_zalo_bo_qua', v_trung)));
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'to_chuc', v_kq);
end $function$

arguments: p_org bigint
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_context_dong_bo_lua_chon(p_org bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_akabiz boolean; v_sp int := 0; v_goi int := 0; v_cd int := 0; v_tat int := 0; n int;
begin
  select coalesce(o.is_admin_akabiz, false) into v_akabiz from public.org_organization o where o.id = p_org;
  if not coalesce(v_akabiz, false) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'bo_qua', 'khong_phai_to_chuc_akabiz');
  end if;

  -- Sản phẩm (lựa chọn chính) cho mọi trường kiểu cặp
  insert into public.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, mo_ta_cho_ai, tu_khoa, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, t.id, 'chinh', p.code, p.name, nullif(btrim(p.description), ''),
         array(select distinct x from unnest(coalesce(p.aliases, '{}'::text[]) || array[lower(p.name)]) x where coalesce(x, '') <> ''),
         'org_product', p.code, p.sort_order, p.is_active
  from public.context_truong_thong_tin t cross join public.org_product p
  where t.organization_id = p_org and t.kieu_gia_tri = 'cap_lua_chon' and not t.is_delete and p.code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$'
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do update
    set name = excluded.name, mo_ta_cho_ai = coalesce(excluded.mo_ta_cho_ai, public.context_lua_chon.mo_ta_cho_ai),
        tu_khoa = excluded.tu_khoa, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, is_active = excluded.is_active
    where public.context_lua_chon.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product'
      and (public.context_lua_chon.name, public.context_lua_chon.tu_khoa, public.context_lua_chon.sort_order, public.context_lua_chon.is_active)
          is distinct from (excluded.name, excluded.tu_khoa, excluded.sort_order, excluded.is_active);
  get diagnostics v_sp = row_count;

  -- Gói (lựa chọn phụ) lấy từ org_product_package.package_type
  with goi as (
    select distinct pp.package_type as code from public.org_product_package pp where pp.package_type ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$'
  ), ten(code, name, tu_khoa, sort_order) as (values
    ('demo','Dùng thử / demo', array['dùng thử','demo','trial','test thử','bản thử'], 1),
    ('month','Gói 1 tháng', array['1 tháng','gói tháng','30 ngày'], 2),
    ('2month','Gói 2 tháng', array['2 tháng','60 ngày'], 3),
    ('6month','Gói 6 tháng', array['6 tháng','nửa năm'], 4),
    ('year','Gói 1 năm', array['1 năm','gói năm','12 tháng'], 5),
    ('2year','Gói 2 năm', array['2 năm','24 tháng'], 6),
    ('4year','Gói 4 năm', array['4 năm'], 7),
    ('unlimited','Gói vĩnh viễn', array['vĩnh viễn','trọn đời','mãi mãi','không thời hạn','lifetime'], 8))
  insert into public.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, tu_khoa, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, t.id, 'phu', g.code, coalesce(n2.name, g.code), coalesce(n2.tu_khoa, '{}'::text[]), 'org_product_package.package_type', g.code, coalesce(n2.sort_order, 50), true
  from public.context_truong_thong_tin t cross join goi g left join ten n2 on n2.code = g.code
  where t.organization_id = p_org and t.kieu_gia_tri = 'cap_lua_chon' and not t.is_delete
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do update
    set name = excluded.name, tu_khoa = excluded.tu_khoa, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, is_active = true
    where public.context_lua_chon.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product_package.package_type'
      and (public.context_lua_chon.name, public.context_lua_chon.tu_khoa, public.context_lua_chon.is_active)
          is distinct from (excluded.name, excluded.tu_khoa, true);
  get diagnostics v_goi = row_count;

  -- Chiến dịch lấy từ auto_campaign_actions
  insert into public.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, t.id, 'chinh', a.id, a.name, 'auto_campaign_actions', a.id,
         (row_number() over (partition by t.id order by a.flatform_type, a.id))::int, true
  from public.context_truong_thong_tin t cross join public.auto_campaign_actions a
  where t.organization_id = p_org and t.code = 'chien_dich_quan_tam' and not t.is_delete
    and coalesce(a.is_active, true) and not coalesce(a.is_delete, false) and a.id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$'
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do update
    set name = excluded.name, is_active = true
    where public.context_lua_chon.bang_tham_chieu = 'auto_campaign_actions'
      and (public.context_lua_chon.name, public.context_lua_chon.is_active) is distinct from (excluded.name, true);
  get diagnostics v_cd = row_count;

  -- Tắt lựa chọn không còn trong danh mục gốc
  update public.context_lua_chon l set is_active = false
  where l.organization_id = p_org and l.is_active and (
       (l.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product' and not exists (select 1 from public.org_product p where p.code = l.ma_tham_chieu and p.is_active))
    or (l.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product_package.package_type' and not exists (select 1 from public.org_product_package pp where pp.package_type = l.ma_tham_chieu))
    or (l.bang_tham_chieu = 'auto_campaign_actions' and not exists (select 1 from public.auto_campaign_actions a where a.id = l.ma_tham_chieu and coalesce(a.is_active, true) and not coalesce(a.is_delete, false))));
  get diagnostics v_tat = row_count;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'san_pham', v_sp, 'goi', v_goi, 'chien_dich', v_cd, 'da_tat', v_tat);
end $function$

arguments: p_org bigint
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_context_khoi_tao_to_chuc(p_org bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_truong int := 0; v_lua_chon int := 0; v_dong_bo jsonb;
begin
  insert into public.context_cai_dat_to_chuc (organization_id, ai_using_code, ai_using_code_tong_hop)
  values (p_org, 'context_trich_tu_chat', 'context_tong_hop_dem')
  on conflict (organization_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.context_truong_thong_tin
    (organization_id, tu_truong_mau_id, code, name, description, nhom_truong, mo_ta_cho_ai, kieu_gia_tri, cach_ghi_nhan,
     lay_ca_cau_nhan_vien, cach_gop_gia_tri, so_ngay_hieu_luc, do_tin_cay_toi_thieu, hien_cho_agent, hien_cho_nhan_vien, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, m.id, m.code, m.name, m.description, m.nhom_truong, m.mo_ta_cho_ai, m.kieu_gia_tri, m.cach_ghi_nhan,
         m.lay_ca_cau_nhan_vien, m.cach_gop_gia_tri, m.so_ngay_hieu_luc, m.do_tin_cay_toi_thieu, m.hien_cho_agent, m.hien_cho_nhan_vien, m.sort_order, m.is_active
  from public.context_truong_thong_tin m
  where m.organization_id is null and not m.is_delete
  on conflict (organization_id, code) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_truong = row_count;

  insert into public.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, mo_ta_cho_ai, tu_khoa, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, o.id, l.vai_tro, l.code, l.name, l.mo_ta_cho_ai, l.tu_khoa, l.bang_tham_chieu, l.ma_tham_chieu, l.sort_order, l.is_active
  from public.context_lua_chon l
  join public.context_truong_thong_tin m on m.id = l.truong_thong_tin_id and m.organization_id is null
  join public.context_truong_thong_tin o on o.organization_id = p_org and o.tu_truong_mau_id = m.id
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_lua_chon = row_count;

  v_dong_bo := public.fn_context_dong_bo_lua_chon(p_org);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'truong_moi', v_truong, 'lua_chon_moi', v_lua_chon, 'dong_bo', v_dong_bo);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_kgt_backfill_review_v1(p_staff_id bigint, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare g record; v_input jsonb; v_old jsonb; v_now timestamptz:=clock_timestamp(); v_count integer:=0;
begin
  if p_staff_id is null or not exists(select 1 from public.org_staff where id=p_staff_id and is_active is true and is_super_admin is true) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok',false,'reason','invalid_actor'); end if;
  for g in select m.id from public.message_gom m left join public.aka_app_settings s on s.key='kgt:'||m.id::text
    where m.account_id=1001 and m.source='pancake' and m.initiated_by='CUSTOMER'
      and coalesce(m.question_first_at,m.created_at)>=v_now-interval '7 days'
      and coalesce(m.conversation_id,'') not like 'pzl_g_%'
      and not exists(select 1 from public.contacts c where c.id=m.contact_id and c.is_group is true)
      and (s.key is null or (s.value->>'status' in ('skipped','rejected','error') and coalesce((s.value->>'applied')::boolean,false) is false
        and coalesce(jsonb_array_length(s.value->'review_history'),0)=0))
    order by coalesce(m.question_first_at,m.created_at),m.id limit least(100,greatest(1,coalesce(p_limit,100)))
  loop
    perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('kgt-queue:'||g.id,0));
    select value into v_old from public.aka_app_settings where key='kgt:'||g.id::text for update;
    if v_old->>'applied'='true' or coalesce(jsonb_array_length(v_old->'review_history'),0)>0
      or (v_old is not null and coalesce(v_old->>'status','') not in ('skipped','rejected','error')) then continue; end if;
    v_input:=public.fn_kgt_input_v2(g.id);
    if v_input is null then continue; end if;
    insert into public.aka_app_settings(key,value,updated_at) values('kgt:'||g.id::text,coalesce(v_old,'{}'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object(
      'v',2,'intake_version','kgt-intake-v1','gom_id',g.id,'status','review','needs_review',true,'review_only',true,'dry_run',true,'applied',false,
      'contact_id',v_input#>'{contact,id}','contact_name',coalesce(v_input#>'{contact,name}',v_input#>'{gom,contact_name}'),
      'shop_id',v_input#>'{gom,shop_id}','shop_id_2',v_input#>'{gom,shop_id_2}','shop_name',v_input#>'{shop,name}',
      'conversation_id',v_input#>'{gom,conversation_id}','message_at',coalesce(v_input#>'{gom,question_first_at}',v_input#>'{gom,created_at}'),
      'owner_org_staff_id',v_input#>'{shop,manager_org_staff_id}','owner_unassigned',v_input#>>'{shop,manager_org_staff_id}' is null,
      'source_binding',v_input->'source_binding','review_due_at',v_now+interval '24 hours',
      'review_reasons',jsonb_build_array('historical_intake_requires_review'),'evidence_hash',v_input->>'evidence_hash',
      'lease_token',null,'lease_until',null,'trigger_source',coalesce(v_old->>'trigger_source','admin_backfill_review_v1'),
      'created_at',coalesce(v_old->'created_at',to_jsonb(v_now)),'updated_at',v_now,
      'review_history',coalesce(v_old->'review_history','[]'::jsonb)||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('action','backfill_review','staff_id',p_staff_id,'at',v_now))),v_now)
      on conflict(key) do update set value=excluded.value,updated_at=excluded.updated_at;
    v_count:=v_count+1;
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok',true,'captured',v_count,'review_only',true);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_kt_context_chay_dem(p_ep boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  s record; r record;
  v_src context_kiem_thu.context_nguon_thu_thap%rowtype;
  v_now_local timestamp; v_start timestamptz; v_kq jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_bu_g int; v_bu_z int; v_th int; v_lk int; v_don int; v_trung jsonb;
begin
  for s in select * from context_kiem_thu.context_cai_dat_to_chuc where is_active loop
    v_now_local := now() at time zone s.mui_gio;
    continue when not p_ep and (v_now_local::time < s.gio_tong_hop_dem or coalesce(s.tong_hop_dem_gan_nhat_ngay >= v_now_local::date, false));
    v_start := date_trunc('day', v_now_local) at time zone s.mui_gio;
    v_bu_g := 0; v_bu_z := 0; v_th := 0; v_don := 0; v_trung := null;

    -- 1) Tài khoản Zalo đã nối Pancake: tin đã vào message_gom nên bỏ qua ở chat_zalo
    v_src := null;
    select n.* into v_src from context_kiem_thu.context_nguon_thu_thap n
     where n.organization_id = s.organization_id and n.bang_nguon = 'public.chat_zalo_message' and n.account_id is null;
    if v_src.id is not null and coalesce((v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin ->> 'tu_dong_cap_nhat_trung_pancake')::boolean, false) then
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x), '[]'::jsonb) into v_trung from (
        select ao.id as x
          from public.chat_zalo_account_organization ao
          join public.chat_zalo_account a on a.id = ao.chat_zalo_account_id
         where ao.organization_id = s.organization_id
           and a.zalo_id in (select split_part(m.conversation_id, '_', 3)
                               from public.message_gom m
                               join context_kiem_thu.context_nguon_thu_thap g on g.organization_id = s.organization_id and g.bang_nguon = 'public.message_gom' and g.account_id = m.account_id
                              where m.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' and m.conversation_id like 'pzl_u_%')
        union
        select (e #>> '{}')::bigint from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids_co_dinh', '[]'::jsonb)) e
      ) t;
      update context_kiem_thu.context_nguon_thu_thap set dieu_kien_loc_tin = jsonb_set(dieu_kien_loc_tin, '{bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids}', v_trung)
       where id = v_src.id and dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids' is distinct from v_trung;
      v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin := jsonb_set(v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin, '{bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids}', v_trung);
    end if;

    -- 1b) Nối lại hồ sơ với aka_customer khi contact được gán khách hàng sau lúc tạo hồ sơ
    v_lk := public.fn_kt_context_dong_bo_lien_ket_aka(s.organization_id);

    -- 2a) Quét bù message_gom: tin khách hôm nay mà hồ sơ chưa đọc tới và không có việc đang chờ
    for r in
      select distinct on (m.contact_id) m.id
        from public.message_gom m
        join context_kiem_thu.context_nguon_thu_thap g on g.organization_id = s.organization_id and g.bang_nguon = 'public.message_gom' and g.account_id = m.account_id and g.is_active
       where m.created_at >= v_start and m.contact_id is not null and coalesce(btrim(m.question_content), '') <> ''
         and coalesce(m.conversation_id, '') not like 'pzl_g_%'
         and not exists (
           select 1 from context_kiem_thu.context_khach_hang_ma km
             join context_kiem_thu.context_khach_hang kh on kh.id = public.fn_kt_context_ho_so_chinh(km.khach_hang_id)
            where km.organization_id = s.organization_id and km.loai_ma = 'contact' and km.gia_tri = m.contact_id::text
              and (kh.la_noi_bo or kh.da_doc_den_luc >= coalesce(m.question_last_at, m.question_first_at, m.created_at)
                   or exists (select 1 from context_kiem_thu.context_lan_thu_thap p where p.khach_hang_id = kh.id and p.status in ('pending', 'processing'))))
       order by m.contact_id, m.created_at desc
    loop
      if public.fn_kt_context_xep_hang('message_gom', r.id::text, 'quet_bu') is not null then v_bu_g := v_bu_g + 1; end if;
    end loop;

    -- 2b) Quét bù chat_zalo: hội thoại cá nhân có tin khách hôm nay chưa được đọc
    if v_src.id is not null and v_src.is_active then
      for r in
        select c.id as conv_id,
               (select m.id from public.chat_zalo_message m
                 where m.organization_id = s.organization_id and m.chat_zalo_conversation_id = c.id and m.direction = 'incoming'
                   and coalesce(btrim(m.content_text), '') <> '' and not m.is_recalled and m.deleted_at is null and m.deletion_scope is null
                 order by m.zalo_sent_at desc nulls last, m.id desc limit 1) as msg_id
          from public.chat_zalo_conversation c
          join public.chat_zalo_account_conversation ac on ac.id = c.chat_zalo_account_conversation_id and ac.conversation_type = 'user'
         where c.organization_id = s.organization_id and c.last_incoming_at >= v_start
           and not (coalesce(v_src.dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids', '[]'::jsonb) @> to_jsonb(c.chat_zalo_account_organization_id))
           and not exists (
             select 1 from context_kiem_thu.context_khach_hang_ma km
               join context_kiem_thu.context_khach_hang kh on kh.id = public.fn_kt_context_ho_so_chinh(km.khach_hang_id)
              where km.organization_id = s.organization_id and km.loai_ma = 'chat_zalo_conversation' and km.gia_tri = c.id::text
                and (kh.la_noi_bo or kh.da_doc_den_luc >= c.last_incoming_at
                     or exists (select 1 from context_kiem_thu.context_lan_thu_thap p where p.khach_hang_id = kh.id and p.status in ('pending', 'processing'))))
      loop
        if r.msg_id is not null and public.fn_kt_context_xep_hang('chat_zalo_message', r.msg_id::text, 'quet_bu') is not null then v_bu_z := v_bu_z + 1; end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    -- 3) Tổng hợp hồ sơ: chạy sau 20 phút để việc trích thông tin vừa xếp hàng xong trước
    insert into context_kiem_thu.context_lan_thu_thap (organization_id, khach_hang_id, ly_do_chay, status, due_at)
    select s.organization_id, k.id, 'tong_hop_dem', 'pending', now() + interval '20 minutes'
      from context_kiem_thu.context_khach_hang k
     where k.organization_id = s.organization_id and not k.la_noi_bo and k.gop_vao_khach_hang_id is null
       and (k.can_tong_hop_lai or exists (select 1 from context_kiem_thu.context_lan_thu_thap p
                                           where p.khach_hang_id = k.id and p.status in ('pending', 'processing') and p.ly_do_chay <> 'tong_hop_dem'))
    on conflict (khach_hang_id, ly_do_chay) where status = 'pending' do nothing;
    get diagnostics v_th = row_count;

    -- 4) Xóa kết quả AI thô quá hạn lưu
    update context_kiem_thu.context_lan_thu_thap set ket_qua_ai = null
     where organization_id = s.organization_id and ket_qua_ai is not null
       and completed_at < now() - make_interval(days => s.so_ngay_luu_ket_qua_ai);
    get diagnostics v_don = row_count;

    update context_kiem_thu.context_cai_dat_to_chuc set tong_hop_dem_gan_nhat_ngay = v_now_local::date where organization_id = s.organization_id;
    v_kq := v_kq || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('organization_id', s.organization_id, 'quet_bu_message_gom', v_bu_g,
              'quet_bu_chat_zalo', v_bu_z, 'noi_lai_aka', v_lk, 'tong_hop', v_th, 'xoa_ket_qua_ai', v_don, 'tai_khoan_zalo_bo_qua', v_trung)));
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'to_chuc', v_kq);
end $function$

arguments: p_ten_mau text, p_tu timestamp with time zone, p_so_gom integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_so_zalo integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_hat_giong double precision DEFAULT 0.42
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_kt_context_chon_mau(p_ten_mau text, p_tu timestamp with time zone, p_so_gom integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_so_zalo integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_hat_giong double precision DEFAULT 0.42)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_gom int; v_zalo int;
begin
  perform setseed(p_hat_giong);
  insert into context_kiem_thu.mau_khach (ten_mau, bang_nguon, khoa_khach, ban_ghi_id)
  select p_ten_mau, 'message_gom', x.contact_id::text, x.id::text
    from (select distinct on (m.contact_id) m.contact_id, m.id
            from public.message_gom m
           where m.account_id = 1001 and m.created_at >= p_tu and m.contact_id is not null
             and coalesce(btrim(m.question_content), '') <> '' and coalesce(m.conversation_id, '') not like 'pzl_g_%'
           order by m.contact_id, m.created_at desc) x
   order by random()
   limit coalesce(p_so_gom, 1000000)
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_gom = row_count;

  insert into context_kiem_thu.mau_khach (ten_mau, bang_nguon, khoa_khach, ban_ghi_id)
  select p_ten_mau, 'chat_zalo_message', c.id::text, t.msg_id::text
    from public.chat_zalo_conversation c
    join public.chat_zalo_account_conversation ac on ac.id = c.chat_zalo_account_conversation_id and ac.conversation_type = 'user'
    cross join lateral (select m.id as msg_id from public.chat_zalo_message m
                         where m.organization_id = 1 and m.chat_zalo_conversation_id = c.id and m.direction = 'incoming'
                           and coalesce(btrim(m.content_text), '') <> '' and not m.is_recalled and m.deleted_at is null and m.deletion_scope is null
                           and m.content_kind in ('text', 'link', 'media', 'file')
                         order by m.zalo_sent_at desc nulls last, m.id desc limit 1) t
   where c.organization_id = 1 and c.last_incoming_at >= p_tu
     and not (coalesce((select n.dieu_kien_loc_tin -> 'bo_qua_tai_khoan_zalo_ids' from context_kiem_thu.context_nguon_thu_thap n where n.bang_nguon = 'public.chat_zalo_message' limit 1), '[]'::jsonb)
              @> to_jsonb(c.chat_zalo_account_organization_id))
   order by random()
   limit coalesce(p_so_zalo, 1000000)
  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_zalo = row_count;
  return jsonb_build_object('ten_mau', p_ten_mau, 'message_gom', v_gom, 'chat_zalo_message', v_zalo);
end $function$

arguments: p_org bigint
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_kt_context_dong_bo_lua_chon(p_org bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_akabiz boolean; v_sp int := 0; v_goi int := 0; v_cd int := 0; v_tat int := 0; n int;
begin
  select coalesce(o.is_admin_akabiz, false) into v_akabiz from public.org_organization o where o.id = p_org;
  if not coalesce(v_akabiz, false) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'bo_qua', 'khong_phai_to_chuc_akabiz');
  end if;

  -- Sản phẩm (lựa chọn chính) cho mọi trường kiểu cặp
  insert into context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, mo_ta_cho_ai, tu_khoa, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, t.id, 'chinh', p.code, p.name, nullif(btrim(p.description), ''),
         array(select distinct x from unnest(coalesce(p.aliases, '{}'::text[]) || array[lower(p.name)]) x where coalesce(x, '') <> ''),
         'org_product', p.code, p.sort_order, p.is_active
  from context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin t cross join public.org_product p
  where t.organization_id = p_org and t.kieu_gia_tri = 'cap_lua_chon' and not t.is_delete and p.code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$'
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do update
    set name = excluded.name, mo_ta_cho_ai = coalesce(excluded.mo_ta_cho_ai, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.mo_ta_cho_ai),
        tu_khoa = excluded.tu_khoa, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, is_active = excluded.is_active
    where context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product'
      and (context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.name, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.tu_khoa, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.sort_order, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.is_active)
          is distinct from (excluded.name, excluded.tu_khoa, excluded.sort_order, excluded.is_active);
  get diagnostics v_sp = row_count;

  -- Gói (lựa chọn phụ) lấy từ org_product_package.package_type
  with goi as (
    select distinct pp.package_type as code from public.org_product_package pp where pp.package_type ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$'
  ), ten(code, name, tu_khoa, sort_order) as (values
    ('demo','Dùng thử / demo', array['dùng thử','demo','trial','test thử','bản thử'], 1),
    ('month','Gói 1 tháng', array['1 tháng','gói tháng','30 ngày'], 2),
    ('2month','Gói 2 tháng', array['2 tháng','60 ngày'], 3),
    ('6month','Gói 6 tháng', array['6 tháng','nửa năm'], 4),
    ('year','Gói 1 năm', array['1 năm','gói năm','12 tháng'], 5),
    ('2year','Gói 2 năm', array['2 năm','24 tháng'], 6),
    ('4year','Gói 4 năm', array['4 năm'], 7),
    ('unlimited','Gói vĩnh viễn', array['vĩnh viễn','trọn đời','mãi mãi','không thời hạn','lifetime'], 8))
  insert into context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, tu_khoa, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, t.id, 'phu', g.code, coalesce(n2.name, g.code), coalesce(n2.tu_khoa, '{}'::text[]), 'org_product_package.package_type', g.code, coalesce(n2.sort_order, 50), true
  from context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin t cross join goi g left join ten n2 on n2.code = g.code
  where t.organization_id = p_org and t.kieu_gia_tri = 'cap_lua_chon' and not t.is_delete
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do update
    set name = excluded.name, tu_khoa = excluded.tu_khoa, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, is_active = true
    where context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product_package.package_type'
      and (context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.name, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.tu_khoa, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.is_active)
          is distinct from (excluded.name, excluded.tu_khoa, true);
  get diagnostics v_goi = row_count;

  -- Chiến dịch lấy từ auto_campaign_actions
  insert into context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, t.id, 'chinh', a.id, a.name, 'auto_campaign_actions', a.id,
         (row_number() over (partition by t.id order by a.flatform_type, a.id))::int, true
  from context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin t cross join public.auto_campaign_actions a
  where t.organization_id = p_org and t.code = 'chien_dich_quan_tam' and not t.is_delete
    and coalesce(a.is_active, true) and not coalesce(a.is_delete, false) and a.id ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]*$'
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do update
    set name = excluded.name, is_active = true
    where context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.bang_tham_chieu = 'auto_campaign_actions'
      and (context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.name, context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon.is_active) is distinct from (excluded.name, true);
  get diagnostics v_cd = row_count;

  -- Tắt lựa chọn không còn trong danh mục gốc
  update context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon l set is_active = false
  where l.organization_id = p_org and l.is_active and (
       (l.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product' and not exists (select 1 from public.org_product p where p.code = l.ma_tham_chieu and p.is_active))
    or (l.bang_tham_chieu = 'org_product_package.package_type' and not exists (select 1 from public.org_product_package pp where pp.package_type = l.ma_tham_chieu))
    or (l.bang_tham_chieu = 'auto_campaign_actions' and not exists (select 1 from public.auto_campaign_actions a where a.id = l.ma_tham_chieu and coalesce(a.is_active, true) and not coalesce(a.is_delete, false))));
  get diagnostics v_tat = row_count;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'san_pham', v_sp, 'goi', v_goi, 'chien_dich', v_cd, 'da_tat', v_tat);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_kt_context_khoi_tao_to_chuc(p_org bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_truong int := 0; v_lua_chon int := 0; v_dong_bo jsonb;
begin
  insert into context_kiem_thu.context_cai_dat_to_chuc (organization_id, ai_using_code, ai_using_code_tong_hop)
  values (p_org, 'context_trich_tu_chat', 'context_tong_hop_dem')
  on conflict (organization_id) do nothing;

  insert into context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin
    (organization_id, tu_truong_mau_id, code, name, description, nhom_truong, mo_ta_cho_ai, kieu_gia_tri, cach_ghi_nhan,
     lay_ca_cau_nhan_vien, cach_gop_gia_tri, so_ngay_hieu_luc, do_tin_cay_toi_thieu, hien_cho_agent, hien_cho_nhan_vien, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, m.id, m.code, m.name, m.description, m.nhom_truong, m.mo_ta_cho_ai, m.kieu_gia_tri, m.cach_ghi_nhan,
         m.lay_ca_cau_nhan_vien, m.cach_gop_gia_tri, m.so_ngay_hieu_luc, m.do_tin_cay_toi_thieu, m.hien_cho_agent, m.hien_cho_nhan_vien, m.sort_order, m.is_active
  from context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin m
  where m.organization_id is null and not m.is_delete
  on conflict (organization_id, code) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_truong = row_count;

  insert into context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon (organization_id, truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code, name, mo_ta_cho_ai, tu_khoa, bang_tham_chieu, ma_tham_chieu, sort_order, is_active)
  select p_org, o.id, l.vai_tro, l.code, l.name, l.mo_ta_cho_ai, l.tu_khoa, l.bang_tham_chieu, l.ma_tham_chieu, l.sort_order, l.is_active
  from context_kiem_thu.context_lua_chon l
  join context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin m on m.id = l.truong_thong_tin_id and m.organization_id is null
  join context_kiem_thu.context_truong_thong_tin o on o.organization_id = p_org and o.tu_truong_mau_id = m.id
  on conflict (truong_thong_tin_id, vai_tro, code) do nothing;
  get diagnostics v_lua_chon = row_count;

  v_dong_bo := public.fn_kt_context_dong_bo_lua_chon(p_org);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'truong_moi', v_truong, 'lua_chon_moi', v_lua_chon, 'dong_bo', v_dong_bo);
end $function$

     where g.customer_id=p_customer_id and coalesce(q.is_deleted,false)=false and q.is_paid and q.expiration_date is not null

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_opp_product_context(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with p as (
    select lower(coalesce(q.product_name,'')) sp, lower(coalesce(q.package_type,'')) goi, q.expiration_date exp
      from public.org_organization_product q join public.org_organization g on g.id=q.organization_id
     where g.customer_id=p_customer_id and coalesce(q.is_deleted,false)=false
    union all
    select lower(coalesce(o.product_list,'')), lower(coalesce(o.package,'')), o.date_expiration
      from public.aka_order o where o.customer_id=p_customer_id
  ), pick as (select * from p order by exp desc nulls last limit 1)
  select coalesce((select jsonb_build_object(
     'product_group', case when sp ~ 'zalo' then 'zalo' when sp ~ 'facebook|fb|fanpage' then 'facebook' when sp ~ 'sms' then 'sms' else 'khac' end,
     'package', case when goi ~ 'demo' then 'demo' when goi ~ 'year|năm' then 'year' when goi ~ 'month|tháng' then '2month' when goi ~ 'forever|unlimited' then 'forever' else goi end,
     'product_raw', sp) from pick), '{"product_group":"zalo","package":null}'::jsonb);
$function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_tao_chuoi_cham_lai_chat(p_day date DEFAULT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date, p_tao_khach_moi boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS TABLE(chuoi integer, moc integer, khach_tao_moi integer, loai_da_mua integer, loai_bao_tt integer, loai_dang_co_lich integer, khong_dinh_danh integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_dau     timestamptz := (p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');
  v_cuoi    timestamptz := ((p_day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');
  v_intents text[] := ARRAY['A1_ASK_PRICE','C2_PURCHASE_UPGRADE','C4_RENEWAL','C5_ASK_DISCOUNT',
                            'A5_REQUEST_TRIAL',
                            'A2_ASK_POLICY','A3_ASK_PRODUCT_INFO','A4_ASK_LIMIT','A6_ASK_INVOICE'];
  v_chuoi int := 0; v_moc  int := 0; v_new  int := 0;
  v_mua   int := 0; v_tt   int := 0; v_lich int := 0; v_skip int := 0;
  r_uv record;
  v_up jsonb;
BEGIN
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- BUOC 1: khach chat chua co ho so aka_customer -> tao moi + gan vao contacts
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IF p_tao_khach_moi THEN
    -- (HÀM CHUNG) tạo hồ sơ khách chat chưa có SĐT qua public.fn_upsert_aka_customer_v1 (khóa zalo_uid + pancake_url), tự gắn contacts.customer_id
    v_new := 0;
    for r_uv in
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.contact_id)
             g.contact_id, ct.name, ct.zalo_name, ct.uid, ct.conversion_id, ct.shop_id,
             (SELECT sh.pancake_page_id FROM public.shops sh
               WHERE sh.id::text = ct.shop_id) AS page_id,
             (SELECT g2.answer_org_staff_id FROM public.message_gom g2
               WHERE g2.contact_id = g.contact_id AND g2.answer_org_staff_id IS NOT NULL
               ORDER BY g2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS owner_id
        FROM public.message_gom g
        JOIN public.contacts ct ON ct.id = g.contact_id
       WHERE g.created_at >= v_dau AND g.created_at < v_cuoi
         AND g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
         AND COALESCE(g.bot_confidence, 0) >= 70
         AND g.bot_intent = ANY (v_intents)
         AND g.aka_customer_id IS NULL
         AND ct.customer_id IS NULL
         AND COALESCE(g.phone, ct.phone, '') = ''
         AND COALESCE(ct.is_group, false) = false
         AND COALESCE(ct.name, ct.zalo_name, '') <> ''
       ORDER BY g.contact_id, g.created_at DESC
    loop
      v_up := public.fn_upsert_aka_customer_v1(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'zalo_uid', r_uv.uid,
        'pancake_url', case when r_uv.page_id is not null and r_uv.conversion_id is not null then format('https://pancake.vn/%s?c_id=%s', r_uv.page_id, r_uv.conversion_id) end,
        'name', coalesce(r_uv.name, r_uv.zalo_name), 'name_zalo', r_uv.zalo_name,
        'channel', 'chat', 'org_staff_id', r_uv.owner_id, 'contact_id', r_uv.contact_id, 'is_split_exempt', true,
        'creation_path', 'chat-followup-v1',
        'custom_fields', jsonb_build_object('nguon', 'chat-followup-v1', 'contact_id', r_uv.contact_id::text, 'contact_uid', r_uv.uid,
                                             'conversion_id', r_uv.conversion_id, 'shop_id', r_uv.shop_id, 'tao_ngay', p_day::text)
      )));
      if coalesce((v_up ->> 'ok')::boolean, false) and coalesce((v_up ->> 'is_new')::boolean, false) then v_new := v_new + 1; end if;
    end loop;
  END IF;

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- BUOC 2: phan loai ung vien mo chuoi
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS _cf_pl;
  CREATE TEMP TABLE _cf_pl ON COMMIT DROP AS
  WITH rule(tier, nhan, rank, prio, kenh, intent_codes, offsets_day) AS (
    VALUES
      ('BUY','hoi gia/mua', 3, 20, 10::bigint,
       ARRAY['A1_ASK_PRICE','C2_PURCHASE_UPGRADE','C4_RENEWAL','C5_ASK_DISCOUNT'],
       ARRAY[1,3,7,14]),
      ('TRIAL','dung thu', 2, 25, 8::bigint,
       ARRAY['A5_REQUEST_TRIAL'],
       ARRAY[1,3,7]),
      ('INTEREST','quan tam', 1, 30, 8::bigint,
       ARRAY['A2_ASK_POLICY','A3_ASK_PRODUCT_INFO','A4_ASK_LIMIT','A6_ASK_INVOICE'],
       ARRAY[1,3])
  ),
  gom AS (
    SELECT g.id AS gom_id, g.contact_id, g.bot_intent, g.bot_confidence, g.created_at,
           g.question_content, g.product_id,
           COALESCE(
             g.aka_customer_id,
             ct.customer_id,
             (SELECT c.id FROM public.aka_customer c
               WHERE normalize_phone(c.phone) = normalize_phone(g.phone)
               ORDER BY c.created_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1)
           ) AS customer_id
      FROM public.message_gom g
      LEFT JOIN public.contacts ct ON ct.id = g.contact_id
     WHERE g.created_at >= v_dau AND g.created_at < v_cuoi
       AND g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
       AND g.bot_intent IS NOT NULL
  ),
  bao_tt AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(g.aka_customer_id, ct.customer_id) AS customer_id
      FROM public.message_gom g
      LEFT JOIN public.contacts ct ON ct.id = g.contact_id
     WHERE g.bot_intent = 'C1_CONFIRM_PAYMENT'
       AND COALESCE(g.bot_confidence, 0) >= 70
       AND g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
       AND g.created_at >= v_dau - interval '14 days'
       AND g.created_at <  v_cuoi
       AND COALESCE(g.aka_customer_id, ct.customer_id) IS NOT NULL
  ),
  matched AS (
    SELECT gom.*, r.tier, r.nhan, r.rank, r.prio, r.kenh, r.offsets_day
      FROM gom JOIN rule r ON gom.bot_intent = ANY (r.intent_codes)
     WHERE COALESCE(gom.bot_confidence, 0) >= 70
       AND gom.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  best AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) *
      FROM matched
     ORDER BY customer_id, rank DESC, bot_confidence DESC, created_at DESC
  )
  SELECT b.gom_id, b.contact_id, b.bot_intent, b.bot_confidence, b.question_content, b.product_id,
         b.customer_id, b.tier, b.nhan, b.prio, b.kenh, b.offsets_day,
         c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
         COALESCE(c.org_staff_id_owner,
           (SELECT s.id FROM public.org_staff s
             WHERE s.is_active AND s.is_data_division
             ORDER BY (SELECT count(*) FROM public.aka_crm r2
                        WHERE r2.org_staff_owner_id = s.id
                          AND r2.cskh_completed_date IS NULL), s.id
             LIMIT 1)) AS owner_id,
         public.fn_trang_thai_mua(b.customer_id) AS trang_thai_mua,
         GREATEST(
           (SELECT max(ao.date_expiration) FROM public.aka_order ao
             WHERE ao.customer_id = b.customer_id
               AND COALESCE(ao.is_demo,false) = false
               AND lower(COALESCE(ao.package,'')) <> 'demo'),
           (SELECT max(oq.expiration_date) FROM public.org_organization_product oq
              JOIN public.org_organization og ON og.id = oq.organization_id
             WHERE og.customer_id = b.customer_id
               AND COALESCE(oq.is_deleted,false) = false AND oq.is_paid)
         ) AS han_cuoi,
         (b.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM bao_tt)) AS bao_tt,
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aka_crm r
                  WHERE r.customer_id = b.customer_id
                    AND r.cskh_completed_date IS NULL
                    AND r.cskh_due_date > v_dau) AS dang_co_lich,
         (COALESCE(c.custom_fields->>'nguon','') = 'chat-followup-v1'
          AND COALESCE(c.custom_fields->>'tao_ngay','') = p_day::text) AS vua_tao
    FROM best b
    JOIN public.aka_customer c ON c.id = b.customer_id;

  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE trang_thai_mua = 'dang_dung'),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE trang_thai_mua <> 'dang_dung' AND bao_tt),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE trang_thai_mua <> 'dang_dung' AND NOT bao_tt AND dang_co_lich)
    INTO v_mua, v_tt, v_lich
    FROM _cf_pl;

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- BUOC 3: de moc, ghi thang vao aka_crm
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WITH keep AS (
    SELECT * FROM _cf_pl
     WHERE trang_thai_mua <> 'dang_dung' AND NOT bao_tt AND NOT dang_co_lich
  ),
  ins AS (
    INSERT INTO public.aka_crm (
      customer_id, customer_name, customer_phone,
      crm_type_id, priority, org_staff_owner_id, organization_id, created_by,
      cskh_due_date, note, task_note, pancake_url,
      suggested_channel_id, suggested_content,
      interest_date, interest_product_ids, is_read,
      source_order_id, source_type,
      gen_status, gen_agent, gen_at, gen_meta)
    SELECT
      k.customer_id, k.customer_name, k.customer_phone,
      19, CASE WHEN k.trang_thai_mua = 'het_han' THEN k.prio - 5 ELSE k.prio END,
      k.owner_id, s.organization_id, k.owner_id,
      ((CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM p_day + o.off) = 0
             THEN p_day + o.off + 1 ELSE p_day + o.off END) + TIME '08:30')
        AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
      format('Ho tro kh %s%s sau %s ngay',
             CASE WHEN k.trang_thai_mua = 'het_han' THEN 'het han ' ELSE '' END,
             k.nhan, o.off),
      format('[%s] %s', k.bot_intent, left(COALESCE(k.question_content, ''), 300)),
      (SELECT format('https://pancake.vn/%s?c_id=%s', sh.pancake_page_id, ct2.conversion_id)
         FROM public.contacts ct2
         JOIN public.shops sh ON sh.id::text = ct2.shop_id
        WHERE ct2.id = k.contact_id
          AND sh.pancake_page_id IS NOT NULL
          AND ct2.conversion_id IS NOT NULL),
      k.kenh,
      (SELECT t.content FROM public.auto_content_templates t
         JOIN public.auto_content_groups gr ON gr.id = t.group_id
        WHERE gr.is_active AND NOT COALESCE(gr.is_delete,false)
          AND NOT COALESCE(t.is_delete,false)
          AND gr.crm_type_ids @> ARRAY[19::bigint]
          AND t.content_type_id = 59
        ORDER BY gr.stt LIMIT 1),
      p_day,
      CASE WHEN k.product_id IS NULL THEN '{}'::bigint[] ELSE ARRAY[k.product_id] END,
      false,
      k.customer_id,
      format('chat_followup:%s:%s', to_char(p_day, 'YYYYMMDD'), o.seq),
      'scheduled', 'chat-followup-v1', now(),
      jsonb_build_object('chain', k.tier, 'seq', o.seq, 'offset', o.off,
                         'd0', p_day::text, 'intent', k.bot_intent,
                         'conf', k.bot_confidence, 'gom_id', k.gom_id::text,
                         'mua', k.trang_thai_mua,
                         'han_cuoi', to_char(k.han_cuoi AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
    FROM keep k
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(k.offsets_day) WITH ORDINALITY AS o(off, seq)
    LEFT JOIN public.org_staff s ON s.id = k.owner_id
    ON CONFLICT (source_order_id, source_type)
            WHERE (source_order_id IS NOT NULL) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING customer_id
  )
  SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id)::int, count(*)::int
    INTO v_chuoi, v_moc FROM ins;

  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- BUOC 4: dem khach van khong dinh danh duoc
  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SELECT count(DISTINCT COALESCE(g.conversation_id, g.id::text))::int INTO v_skip
    FROM public.message_gom g
    LEFT JOIN public.contacts ct ON ct.id = g.contact_id
   WHERE g.created_at >= v_dau AND g.created_at < v_cuoi
     AND g.initiated_by = 'CUSTOMER'
     AND g.aka_customer_id IS NULL AND ct.customer_id IS NULL
     AND COALESCE(g.phone, ct.phone, '') = ''
     AND g.bot_intent = ANY (v_intents);

  INSERT INTO public.aka_cron_log
    (job_name, trigger_source, status, total_found, created_count,
     skipped_count, not_found_count, error_count, summary, details)
  VALUES
    ('chat-followup', 'scheduler', 'success',
     v_chuoi + v_mua + v_tt + v_lich, v_moc, v_mua + v_tt + v_lich, v_skip, 0,
     format('Ngay %s | %s chuoi, %s moc | tao moi %s khach | loai: %s dang dung, %s bao TT, %s dang co lich | %s khong dinh danh',
            p_day, v_chuoi, v_moc, v_new, v_mua, v_tt, v_lich, v_skip),
     jsonb_build_object('ngay', p_day, 'chuoi', v_chuoi, 'moc', v_moc,
                        'khach_tao_moi', v_new, 'loai_da_mua', v_mua,
                        'loai_bao_tt', v_tt, 'loai_dang_co_lich', v_lich,
                        'khong_dinh_danh', v_skip));

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_chuoi, v_moc, v_new, v_mua, v_tt, v_lich, v_skip;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_trang_thai_mua(p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aka_order o
                  WHERE o.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(o.is_demo,false) = false
                    AND lower(COALESCE(o.package,'')) <> 'demo'
                    AND o.date_expiration >= now())
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.org_organization_product q
                   JOIN public.org_organization g ON g.id = q.organization_id
                  WHERE g.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(q.is_deleted,false) = false
                    AND q.is_paid
                    AND COALESCE(q.is_lock,false) = false
                    AND q.expiration_date >= now())
    THEN 'dang_dung'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.aka_order o
                  WHERE o.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(o.is_demo,false) = false
                    AND lower(COALESCE(o.package,'')) <> 'demo')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.org_organization_product q
                   JOIN public.org_organization g ON g.id = q.organization_id
                  WHERE g.customer_id = p_customer_id
                    AND COALESCE(q.is_deleted,false) = false
                    AND q.is_paid)
    THEN 'het_han'
    ELSE 'chua_mua'
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_zalo_chat_referral_candidates_v1(p_limit integer DEFAULT 4)
 RETURNS TABLE(message_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select g.id
  from public.message_gom g
  where upper(coalesce(g.initiated_by, '')) = 'CUSTOMER'
    and g.zalo_referral_enqueued_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
    and g.zalo_referral_processed_at is null
    and (g.zalo_referral_processing_until is null or g.zalo_referral_processing_until < now())
    and public.fn_zalo_chat_referral_message_eligible_v1(g.id)
    and (nullif(btrim(g.shared_phone), '') is not null or public.fn_zalo_contact_card_flag_v1(g.zalo_info))
    and (
      coalesce(g.zalo_referral_attempt_count, 0) < 3
      or (
        coalesce(g.zalo_referral_attempt_count, 0) < 4
        and g.zalo_referral_last_status = 'processing'
        and (
          exists (select 1 from public.aka_crm c where c.source_type like 'zalo_referral:%' and c.source_type = 'zalo_referral:' || g.id::text)
          or exists (select 1 from public.ai_log l where l.using_code = 'zalo_chat_referral_verify_v1'
                       and l.block_name = 'zalo-chat-referral-precreate-v1' and l.node_id = 'zalo-referral:' || g.id::text
                       and l.status = 'success' and l.sanitized_request ->> 'evidence_hash' = g.zalo_referral_evidence_hash)
        )
      )
    )
  order by g.zalo_referral_enqueued_at, g.created_at, g.id
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 4), 1), 8);
